title: Creative Designer (DTC)
description:
Our client, a fast-growing eCommerce company in the Patient Care space, with a strong presence in the Home Medical Equipment (HME) and Durable Medical Equipment (DME) niche, is seeking a detail-oriented and execution-focused professional to fill an immediate full-time remote Creative Designer (DTC, Direct-to-Consumer) opening.

As the Creative Designer (DTC), you will execute DTC creatives (video editing & graphic design) for ads, web, email, and organic content by translating clear creative direction into fast, consistent, and high-quality outputs. You will contribute to the growth of the company's DTC channel by creating and iterating new creatives based on feedback, while keeping all assets organized and properly stored.

About the company:

The company is a purpose-driven provider of Patient Care products dedicated to improving the lives of patients and caregivers. With thousands of positive reviews and a globally distributed team, the company focuses on creating practical, well-designed solutions that address real-world caregiving needs.

Customer obsession is at the core of the company's culture, guiding decision-making and product development. The mission is to enhance well-being through thoughtful design and continuous feedback loops, while the vision is to empower patients and caregivers through innovative and accessible products. The company fosters a supportive, high-performance environment that values ownership, growth, and meaningful contribution.

Key Responsibilities:

Execute DTC Ad Creatives for Meta Ads

  • Edit UGC videos and branded videos following provided scripts, references, and direction, ensuring creatives are clear, visually engaging, and aligned with DTC ad formats and standards.
  • Create static creatives following provided scripts, references, and direction, ensuring creatives are clear, visually engaging, and aligned with DTC ad formats and standards.
  • Create and iterate on variations of top-performing creatives based on DTC Lead feedback and performance insights.

Execute Web and Funnel Creative Assets

  • Design visuals for website pages and landing pages (images, banners, sections, etc.), ensuring designs are clean, clear, and aligned with brand and conversion goals.

Execute Email Creative Design

  • Design and update email creatives in Figma (or similar platform) for email flows and campaigns based on provided copy and direction, ensuring clear structure, strong visual quality, and alignment with brand and campaign needs.

Execute Organic Content Editing for Instagram

  • Edit and prepare video and photo content for Instagram (posts, reels, and stories), ensuring clear structure, strong pacing, and a clean, professional, and consistent visual style aligned with brand guidelines.

Maintain Creative Asset Organization & Hygiene

  • Maintain all creative assets organized, properly named, and stored within the defined folder structure, ensuring easy access, version control, and complete, ready-to-use deliverables.

Qualifications:

  • 1–3 years of experience creating video and image creatives for ads, social media, or e-commerce, with a basic understanding of Meta Ads (hooks, pacing, clarity).
  • 1–3 years of experience using tools such as Figma, Adobe Suite, CapCut, Premiere Pro, or similar, including AI tools for image and video creation.
  • 1+ years of experience following creative direction and brand guidelines and translating them into clear and consistent designs.
  • 1+ years of experience creating ads, UGC videos, or social content, or a portfolio showcasing real client or brand work, with an emphasis on clear and effective creatives rather than polished perfection.

Core Competencies & Values:

  • Attention to detail: does not let important details slip through the cracks or derail a project.
  • Commitment (Work ethic): possesses a strong willingness to work hard and sometimes long hours to get the job done. Has a track record of working hard.
  • Consistency (Persistency): demonstrates tenacity and willingness to go the distance to get something done.
  • Growth (Strategic thinking & Visioning): able to see and communicate the big picture in an inspiring way (determine opportunities and threats through comprehensive analysis of current and future trends).
  • Problem solver (Proactivity): acts without being told what to do. Brings new ideas to the company.
  • Trust (Honesty/integrity): does not cut corners ethically, earns trust and maintains confidences. Speaks plainly and truthfully.
  • Efficiency: produces a high volume of creative assets quickly while maintaining quality and minimizing wasted effort.
  • Flexibility/adaptability: adjusts quickly to changes in creative direction, feedback, and priorities without friction.
  • Openness to criticism and ideas: often solicits feedback and reacts calmly to criticism or negative feedback.
  • Organization & Planning: keeps files, assets, and tasks well organized, ensuring easy access and clear structure.
  • Creativity / Innovation: develops variations and new ideas from top-performing creatives and DTC Lead feedback, improving and expanding existing concepts.
  • Teamwork: collaborates closely with the DTC team to stay aligned on creative direction, priorities, and execution.

What We Offer:

  • Full-time remote position in a rapidly growing international company.
  • Direct impact on DTC growth through creative execution.
  • High ownership and autonomy in day-to-day work.
  • A performance-driven and feedback-oriented culture.
  • Competitive compensation based on experience.
  • Annual fully sponsored company trips.
  • Quarterly performance-based bonuses.
  • Paid Time Off: Local public holidays plus two weeks of paid vacation annually.
  • Long-term growth opportunities aligned with company expansion.

This is an excellent opportunity for a creative professional who thrives in a fast-paced DTC environment, combines speed with consistency, and is motivated by clear creative direction, performance feedback, and continuous improvement.

At PNC, our people are our greatest differentiator and competitive advantage in the markets we serve. We are all united in delivering the best experience for our customers. description:

We believe that our diverse teams and strong company culture are key to the success of our products and technologies, that hundreds of millions of users around the world and around 645,000 customers across all industries rely on. With more than 1,900 employees worldwide, we celebrate the unique perspectives and talents that each individual brings to the table and foster a dynamic work environment where new ideas thrive. Are you ready to join our team and make an impact?

Responsibilities

At TeamViewer we’re on a mission to make it possible for each of our users to provide the best support to their customers via a remote device and be able to solve any problem in the most complex environments. As a Product Designer, you will bring a creative mindset to the heart of our engineering and product teams and play an essential role in impacting our products at TeamViewer.

You are a fountain of ideas and a generalist designer who loves playing with new creative concepts, design frameworks and have an innate product and UX/UI sense. You’re a passionate designer interested in learning new things every day and sharing big ideas, but who can fully create a mock and grasp technical aptitude to deliver impeccable design craftmanship. You always search for the best design solution even if it means learning a new concept, uncovering new customer opportunities and use cases, and never forgetting that our design is user-centric — it’s all about people.

  • Design product concepts that balance vision, business potential and intuitive user experiences.

  • Craft every detail for new product features from ideation to pixel-perfect execution.

  • Work closely with our UX Research team and connect with our customers to understand their needs and integrate feedback into product roadmaps and design iterations.

  • Collaborate with developers, product managers, and team leads to support implementation and address any design-related queries to drive your vision to the ship line.

  • Support our evolving design system intentionally as we scale.

  • Design within technical, business, and time constraints, ensuring a balance between innovation and practicality.

  • Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in UX/UI design within a product or software development team.

  • Well-rounded skills and experience to run projects independently end to end.

  • Experience in creating prototypes or detailed mockups to create clear and visually appealing human interfaces.

  • Proficiency in communicating complex design concepts clearly across different levels of the organization.

  • Strong understanding of user-centered design, user research, user testing, rapid prototyping, usability, and accessibility. Proven skills and working history in design and implementation of automated test plans

  • We celebrate diversity as one of core values, join and drive one of the c-a-r-e initiatives together with us!

TeamViewer is an equal opportunities employer and is committed to building an inclusive culture where everyone feels welcome and supported. We C-A-R-E and understand that our diverse, values-driven culture makes us stronger.   • Access great benefits, exclusive discounts and valuable employee perks

About Us

DuluxGroup is a leading marketer and manufacturer of premium brands that help people create better spaces to live and work. With a heritage of over 100 years, we’re home to trusted names like Dulux, Selleys, Yates, Cabot’s, and B&D, delivering products across paints, coatings, adhesives, garden care, and home improvement. As part of Nippon Paint Holdings, we combine global scale with strong local roots, driven by innovation, sustainability, and a commitment to our customers.

Our Group Functions cover Supply Chain, Sales Capability, Finance, People & Culture, IT & Digital, and Legal are an integral part of our Business Units that enable growth and operational excellence. They provide the insights, technology, and expertise that keep our businesses agile and future ready. Joining DuluxGroup means contributing to iconic brands, working in a collaborative culture, and enjoying opportunities for career growth and flexibility.

Join our IT team in one of many newly created roles at the heart of DuluxGroup’s digital transformation, helping deliver a major business upgrade across SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Databricks.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Design, implement, and improve modern workplace and AI solutions
  • Partner with stakeholders to understand business needs
  • Support collaboration, productivity, information-sharing, and digital employee experience initiatives
  • Identify opportunities to simplify processes and improve the user experience
  • Support governance, security, accessibility, and operational requirements
  • Monitor feedback and service performance to support continuous improvement

Our Benefits

  • Up to $1,000 net annually to cover private health extras gap costs
  • Exclusive discounts on DuluxGroup products and partner offers
  • Stay active anytime, anywhere through our partnership with Fitness Passport
  • 20 weeks paid parental leave (primary carers) and 2 weeks partner leave from day one
  • Market leading learning, development and career pathways
  • Access to our Wellbeing Hub and full EAP support

What We’re Looking for

  • Proven enterprise engineering experience across Microsoft 365, Power Platform, Copilot Studio, Azure integrations or equivalent platforms
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • The ability to translate technical concepts into clear, user-friendly language
  • Confidence working with technical specialists, business stakeholders, and end users
  • A collaborative approach and a strong commitment to customer experience
  • The ability to manage competing priorities and deliver high-quality outcomes

We Value Potential and Passion

At DuluxGroup, we believe that the right attitude and a willingness to learn can be just as important as meeting every requirement on a job description. If you’re passionate about IT and excited about this role, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all the essential criteria. We value diverse experiences and perspectives, and we are committed to providing opportunities for growth and development.

Why Join Us?

Progressing your career with the DuluxGroup means being part of a network of over 8000 employees globally who believe in our purpose to ‘Imagine a Better Place’

title: AI Engineer
description:
We are hiring AI Engineers at all levels, seeking individuals who have built and shipped production-grade AI Agents and have deep hands-on experience in Agentic AI.

In this role, you will lead end-to-end development of autonomous AI agents that power our core media business. From architecting agentic workflows and RAG systems to deploying scalable, reliable LLM-powered products, you will play a central role in building the intelligent systems that enable audience growth, editorial excellence, and commercial innovation.

This is a compelling opportunity to shape high-impact AI products, work alongside senior leadership, and bring Agentic AI into production at national scale.

B. ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Agentic AI & Production AI Agents

  • Design, build, and deploy production-grade AI Agents with capabilities in reasoning, planning, tool-use, memory, and multi-step task execution
  • Architect agentic workflows and orchestration frameworks (e.g. LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI or in-house) that are scalable, observable, and reliable at scale
  • Build LLM-powered applications including RAG pipelines, autonomous research agents, content intelligence agents, and workflow automation agents for Editorial, Subscriptions, and Advertising

AI Platform & Infrastructure

  • Develop the foundational platform for AI Agents - including agent registry, evaluation framework, prompt management, vector stores, memory layers, and tool integrations
  • Build robust data pipelines and feature pipelines that feed AI Agents with high-quality structured and unstructured data from our data lake ecosystem
  • Implement guardrails, safety checks, hallucination detection, and human-in-the-loop systems to ensure trustworthy and responsible AI

AI Product Development

  • Own core AI products from prototype to production - audience intelligence agents, personalization agents, content generation and summarization agents
  • Optimize agents for latency, cost, accuracy, and user experience in a live production environment
  • Partner with Product, Editorial, and Commercial teams to translate ambiguous business problems into well-scoped agentic solutions

Governance, Evaluation & Excellence

  • Establish evaluation metrics and observability for AI Agents - accuracy, faithfulness, task success rate, latency, and cost
  • Champion best practices in LLMOps, versioning, CI/CD for AI, and model governance
  • Stay at the forefront of Agentic AI, LLMs, and multimodal models, evaluating practical applicability to SPH Media

C. WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Educational Qualifications

  • An advanced degree (Master's or PhD) in Computer Science, AI/ML, Data Science, or a related quantitative field
  • Candidates without a formal advanced degree who can demonstrate equivalent depth through a strong portfolio of production AI Agents are equally encouraged to apply

Technical Experience

  • Production Agentic AI : Minimum 3-6 years of hands-on experience building and shipping AI / ML systems, with at least 2+ years specifically building Production AI Agents. Proven track record of deploying Agentic AI systems with tool calling, function calling, planning & reasoning, memory, and multi-agent collaboration in production. Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks: LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel or similar
  • LLM & AI Stack: Strong hands-on experience with LLMs (OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, open-source LLMs), RAG architectures, vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, pgvector), and embedding models. Experience fine-tuning, prompt engineering, and evaluating LLMs for production use cases. Experience with AI-powered solutions involving unstructured data - text, images, video
  • Core Engineering Skills: Deep proficiency in Python, and strong skills in SQL, Spark or similar data processing frameworks. Coding tests may be required. Experience building scalable APIs, microservices, and event-driven systems to serve AI Agents (FastAPI, Docker, Kubernetes)Solid understanding of MLOps / LLMOps, observability, and data governance best practices
  • Functional Skills. Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate complex AI concepts for technical and non-technical stakeholders. Comfortable working in cross-functional, fast-moving environments where priorities evolve quickly. Experience in media, internet, or content-heavy industries is a strong advantage

Responsibilities:

The TeamViewer Digital Employee Experience (DEX) platform finds and resolves IT issues before they affect users. Over the past several years we have successfully built and released products which makes IT administrators' day-to-day life easier. Our vision is to become THE unified endpoint management solution for our customers.

We are looking for a team lead with experience working across servers and clients with knowledge of Ruby On Rails, C++, JavaScript and more. You will lead the work to bring capabilities from our Observability platform into our DEX platform. This will involve making technical decisions about the best way we can integrate to provide our users with the best customer experience whilst ensuring that we can converge our 2 platforms into a single unified, scalable, maintainable platform.

Our observability platform consists of an agent (C++, QT, Electron, JavaScript), a UI (React, Vue, Angular) and a backend (Ruby on Rails, MongoDB, MySQL, AWS EC2). Our DEX platform consists of an agent (C++), a UI (React) and a backend (C# .Net Core 8 running on Azure Kubernetes Service, Azure SQL Managed Instance, PostgreSQL, EventHub, Kafka, Databricks).

You will own the delivery of the roadmap, working closely with our existing observability team that is US-based to deliver the integration whilst also supporting the maintenance of the existing platform.

  • Own delivery roadmap and technical direction for integrating the acquired product into our platform and delivery of new features.

  • Drive architectural decisions that meet product requirements whilst considering key non-functional requirements such as scalability, security and maintainability – taking an approach that aligns with our north star of converging to a single unified platform.

  • Align stakeholders (Product, Security, Operations) and manage risks, dependencies and scope.

  • Ensure adherence to engineering standards: CI/CD quality gates, secure SDLC, and observability/SLOs.

  • Coach and develop the team; enable predictable delivery and continuous improvement.


Requirements:

  • A university or college degree in the field of Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems or a related subject

  • 12+ years of software development experience with at least 2 years as Team Lead / Team Manager for an Agile team.

  • Experienced in leading delivery of cloud-based solution that has required collaboration across different teams.

  • Experience with Azure/AWS cloud services such as: Kafka, Kubernetes, Redis, event streaming

  • Experience leading project delivery in collaboration with remote teams

  • Experience working with C++, JavaScript and QT

  • Experience applying engineering practices and patterns for the full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing and operations.

  • Solid knowledge of Secure SDLC principles, OWASP Top-10 vulnerabilities & remediation, and Threat Modeling

  • Strong communication skills to customers, business and technical partners

  • Strong data-driven mindset and a great attention to detail

  • A pragmatic, outcome-focused mindset that balances technical excellence with business needs and delivery timelines.

  • A spirit of lifelong learning and eagerness to tackle new challenges every day

  • Fluency in English is mandatory.

  • Experience working with network protocols such as TCP/IP, BGP, DNS, SSL/TLS, UDP, SIP, RTP is a plus.

title: Lead UX Designer, VCS ProShop Asset Management - Spain Remote (ES)
description:
Our Team

VistaPrint is the go-to partner for millions of small and medium sized businesses who need to promote themselves effectively in the modern age. With tools that empower brands to create their unique identity and expert design support when they need inspiration, we provide a range of digital and print services at every stage of their journey.

To help customers bring their visions to life, we’re looking for UX professionals skilled at crafting the right features and experiences - that’s where you come in. As a remote-first company, we empower you to thrive from wherever you are while staying connected to a global team.

What you’ll do

VistaPrint is looking for a Lead UX Designer located in Spain to join our VistaPrint Pro product experience group. This covers a suite of enterprise and consumer-facing solutions that simplify how teams create, manage, and order custom print and promotional items across all their locations.

More specifically, you’ll focus on the experience for both admins and customers: enabling admins to create and manage Branded Products and permissions, and helping customers better and more easily express their brand consistently throughout their marketing materials. You’ll approach the experience holistically, partnering with product teams to ensure the experience is seamless, scalable, and best-in-class. You’ll also partner with your product team to influence and align the roadmap to deliver customer-obsessed product experiences.

Here’s a list more comprehensive view of what we expect:

  • Drive end-to-end experiences helping Admins create, design, and organize Branded Products (A physical product that has had a brand/design applied to it).

  • Responsible for the user experience for the ProShop Asset Management team from discovery to delivery, using user-centered design methods to craft simple and intuitive design solutions to complex challenges.

  • Deeply involved at every stage of the design and development process, from discovery through detailed design, execution, and iteration. Creating high-quality user flows, wireframes, clear UI, and prototypes, on your own or by collaborating with other designers.

  • A valuable partner to cross-functional teams, including brainstorming with collaborators around product problems, solutions, requirements and priorities.

  • Part of the decision-making process to identify and prioritize strategic product design work, and how initiatives are explored and performed upon.

  • A partner to data, consumer insights, and UX research teams for foundational guidance on product direction, and new concept validation.

  • Responsible for ensuring cohesiveness with the VistaPrint design system and VistaPrint Pro marketing brand guidelines.

  • An evangelist for user-centered design methods within the domain and across VistaPrint.

Your Qualifications:

At VistaPrint, we are striving to hire individuals that add new ideas and perspectives to our teams and enhance our culture. No matter your background or work experience, we strongly encourage you to apply—even if you feel that you don’t meet the exact requirements or have the same qualifications. You might be a great candidate for this or other opportunities.

  • 5+ years of experience designing sophisticated digital products, preferably with experience in enterprise tools.

  • 4+ years of experience working collaboratively with product, engineering, design, content and user research teams.

  • Strong portfolio showcasing industry leading UX/UI skills, and how you leverage AI through multiple case studies demonstrating user-centered, creative, highly conceptual, and innovative design solutions that had measurable positive impact for users and the business.

  • Experience utilizing quantitative and qualitative data to inspire design decisions and solutions.

  • Ability to move between high level design and detailed design, and between future concepting and near-term implementation.

  • Ability to build strong cross functional relationships with cross functional peers, including designers, product managers, and engineers.

  • Ability to clearly present design concepts and solutions to a variety of audiences.

  • Highly skilled with type, hierarchy, color, composition, contrast, and other graphic design fundamentals.

  • Passionate about design trends, tools, processes, and methodologies, and willing to learn and share new insights with the team.

  • Highly skilled with design tools such as Figma

  • Clear examples of using AI tooling to accelerate research, discovery, and prototyping (e.g. Lovable/Open Code/Cursor/Paper)

  • Experience working with globally distributed teams, and/or in highly matrixed organizations.

Nice to Have:

  • Relevant degree in field of Design or HCI.

  • Ability to plan, moderate, and complete a variety of goal-oriented workshops across collaborators, leading to exciting new ideas, new-found consensus, and critical alignment.

  • Experience designing across responsible web and native mobile platforms, as well as within large-scale digital ecosystems.

  • Experience identifying and prioritizing features, as well as participating in complex roadmap planning.

Why You'll Love Working Here

There is a lot to love about working at VistaPrint. We are an award winning Remote-First company. We’re an inclusive community. We’re growing (which means you can too). And to help orient us all in the same direction, we have our Vista Behaviors which exemplify the behavioral attributes that make us a culturally strong and high-performing team.

About Us

VistaPrint is the design and marketing partner to millions of small businesses around the world. For over 20 years we’ve been inspired by small businesses, and we work incessantly to deliver solutions to their evolving needs. Together, VistaCreate, 99designs by Vista and VistaPrint represent a full-service design, digital and print solution, elevating small businesses’ presence in physical and digital spaces and powering them to achieve success. VistaPrint is focused on making great marketing and design accessible to every small business owner, allowing them to create a cohesive brand image for use in-store, online and on-the-go.

Commitment to Diversity, Equity, & Inclusion

VistaPrint exists to help our customers live their dreams. Each dream is unique – and the VistaPrint team needs to be as well. We believe in the unique contributions of everyone within a diverse global organization. We are collaborative, inclusive, and innovative. We strive to role model and live an inclusive culture of fairness, respect and belonging for all. And we work together to empower each other, creating a space in which each of us can spark our next great idea.

title: Lead Product Manager - Lumen.Com (Remote, US)
description:
Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

The Role

The Product Manager, Marketing Digital Experience – BAU Portfolio owns the operational framework that enables efficient delivery of marketing-driven work across Lumen.com. This role manages the intake, prioritization, governance, and continuous improvement of the Business as Usual (BAU) value stream, ensuring requests are properly scoped, routed, prioritized, and prepared for execution.
Serving as the connective point between business stakeholders and delivery teams, this position helps translate business needs into actionable work while providing transparency into priorities, capacity, timelines, and outcomes. The role partners closely with Campaigns, Creative, Digital Experience (DX), Marketing Operations (MOps), Product Marketing, Analytics, and Technology teams to maintain an efficient and scalable delivery ecosystem.
As a senior individual contributor, this position drives consistency, operational excellence, and continuous improvement through influence, collaboration, and process leadership rather than direct people management.

Work Location

Fully remote position open to candidates based anywhere in the U.S.

The Main Responsibilities

Portfolio Ownership

Own the operating model for Lumen's Business as Usual (BAU) digital delivery portfolio.
Lead the end-to-end delivery of marketing campaigns, product launches, website enhancements, and operational requests across Lumen.com.
Develop and maintain prioritization frameworks that balance business value, customer impact, delivery timelines, capacity, and risk.
Align BAU work with broader Digital Experience priorities and roadmaps.
Partner with value stream leaders to optimize planning, resource utilization, and delivery effectiveness.

Intake, Prioritization & Delivery Management

Own the end-to-end intake, triage, and prioritization process, ensuring work is aligned to business objectives, delivery capacity, and strategic priorities.
Partner with stakeholders to gather requirements, resolve competing priorities, and provide transparency into delivery plans, timelines, and trade-off decisions.
Establish standards, workflows, and governance practices that improve intake quality, delivery readiness, and execution efficiency.
Drive continuous improvement through analysis of intake trends, stakeholder feedback, and operational performance.

Governance & Operational Excellence

Define, implement, and evolve scalable governance, prioritization, and execution frameworks supporting marketing delivery across Lumen.com.
Establish operational metrics, service expectations, and reporting that provide visibility into demand, throughput, portfolio health, and business outcomes.
Identify bottlenecks and lead process improvement, automation, and workflow modernization initiatives that enhance efficiency, predictability, and stakeholder satisfaction.
Promote adoption of governance standards and best practices across partner organizations.

Cross-Functional Leadership

Serve as the primary point of coordination among Digital Experience, Campaigns, Creative, Marketing Operations, Product Marketing, Analytics, and other stakeholder groups.
Build strong partnerships that enable effective planning, prioritization, execution, and delivery.
Translate business needs into actionable work and facilitate resolution of cross-functional challenges impacting delivery timelines, quality, and business outcomes.
Influence decision-making through data, collaboration, business context, and subject matter expertise while fostering a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.

Performance Measurement & Continuous Improvement

Develop and maintain KPIs, dashboards, and reporting that measure portfolio health, delivery performance, stakeholder satisfaction, and business impact.
Partner with Analytics and Digital Experience teams to evaluate performance, identify optimization opportunities, and implement process, workflow, and governance enhancements.
Analyze delivery trends, demand, capacity, and operational metrics to improve efficiency, predictability, and stakeholder experience.

What We Look For in a Candidate

Experience

8+ years of experience in digital experience, product management, marketing operations, campaign management, portfolio management, project management, or a related field.
Experience operating in a complex, matrixed environment with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities.
Experience managing intake, prioritization, governance, and delivery across cross-functional teams.
Hands-on experience with marketing work management platforms such as Adobe Workfront.
Experience with web and content management platforms; Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) preferred.
Experience working within Agile and/or SAFe delivery models preferred.
Demonstrated success driving outcomes through influence and cross-functional leadership.

Skills

title: Technical Superintendent - New Ship
description:
Who We Are Mercy Ships is a global faith-based charity that uses hospital ships to bring life-changing surgeries and transformational medical training to people in some of the most challenging contexts along the African coast. For over 40 years, Mercy Ships has been delivering lasting hope and healing through safe surgical care, while working alongside partners and stakeholders to strengthen local healthcare systems in more than 55 countries. Since the inception of this dream by founders Don and Deyon Stephens in 1978, Mercy Ships has served more than 2.7 million direct beneficiaries without regard for race, gender, or religion. Do you have a heart for the hurting and a desire to invest your talents and experiences into a mission with eternal significance? For every transformative surgery that takes place onboard one of our Mercy Ships, there are dozens of men and women being used of the Lord to prepare the way through their vocational gifts and talents!

This is a full-time remote role that requires international travel.

  • Annual Compensation Range is $90,000-$96,900
  • Compensation range listed is for U.S. hires only. Actual compensation may vary dependent upon location of hire.

As a Technical Superintendent you will manage the preparations required to take delivery of the Africa Mercy II and bring it into operations to sail and begin her field service operations

This includes creating operational documentation, maintenance plans, parts and supplies for the ship to enter service upon delivery. Once delivered transition into the role of Technical Superintendent. Prepare and submit any necessary Warranty Claims

How You'll Contribute:

  • Develop and coordinate SMS documentation, regulatory documentation and shipboard manuals.
  • Oversee and support the building of the planned maintenance system and upon delivery monitor routine and corrective maintenance onboard assigned vessel
  • In conjunction with Director of New Building ensure all necessary classification and Flag State requirements are in place to ensure timely Delivery then monitor such documents to ensure completion of scheduled surveys and/or attention to identified defects
  • Oversee preparation of work plans for technical areas for equipping phase and initial field service, while planning for annual maintenance phases, including drydocking when required.
  • Review requests for repairs and/or modifications to determine compliance with statutory regulations and classification society rules.
  • As necessary, inspect machinery, equipment, or spaces outlined in work and modification requests; draw up job specifications; and obtain bids from contractors or shipyards to perform repairs. (Both Warranty and non-warranty work)
  • Maintain contact with contractors to ensure completion of work according to contract terms.
  • Investigate machinery casualties to determine cause; advise ships officers in methods of operation to prevent recurrence of casualty or malfunction.
  • Plan supply stocks for all marine operations specialties to ensure engineers, plumbing, electrical, hotel engineer, and deck have the repair parts and consumables on hand to sustain the safe operation of the ship.
  • Maintain records of technical expenses for each ship such as repairs, supplies, and personnel.
  • Liaise with regulatory agencies to ensure that requirements for alterations, repairs, or modifications are kept at minimum cost consistent with safety.
  • Review and advise on qualifications of technical staff and/or applicants as requested.
  • Maintain proficient knowledge of Company SMS; assist QHSE Manager to ensure safe working practices are followed onboard.
  • Visit the from time to time during construction and equipping (final fit out) as well as after the vessel is operational and in field service. Conduct the annual Company Vessel Inspection after Delivery
  • Other duties as assigned.

Ideal Candidate:

  • Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, or governmental regulations. Ability to write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals. Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of managers, contractors, suppliers, and the general public
  • Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions. Ability to interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form and deal with several abstract and concrete variables.
  • Ability to travel nationally and internationally.
  • Preference is to work from Mercy Ships International Support Center in Lindale, Texas – remote work may be considered
  • Certificate of Competency in accordance with STCW III/2 required; Chief Engineer preferred.
  • Supportive of Mercy Ships mission and vision and committed to its core values.
  • Understand and apply servant leadership, work collaboratively with integrity and demonstrate accountability.

Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree (B.Sc.) from four-year College or University; with 10 years related industry experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Two or more years of service aboard ROPAX or Cruise vessels to provide the necessary background in sustaining a vessel with a substantial crew aboard.
  • Successful completion of Mercy Ships Entry Training will be required within the first year.

Pour your God-given talents into a mission with eternal return on investment -- join the Mercy Ships Crew, today! This is a paid position. To explore our many Mercy Ships volunteer opportunities, please visit us at:

Connecteam is the leading platform for managing deskless teams, trusted by over 80,000 businesses worldwide.

We built Connecteam for real operators - the people running shifts, jobs, and teams across stores and sites. The kind of work that doesn’t happen behind a desk, and doesn’t have time for messy spreadsheets, scattered group chats, or tools that don’t talk to each other.

Connecteam brings daily operations and team communication into one intuitive app - from hiring and scheduling to training, tasks, and day-to-day coordination. It gives teams the clarity and control to run the day, shift after shift, job after job.

title: [MLA] Senior Site Reliability Engineer - AI Experience Framework
description:
Project – the aim you'll have

We are the AI Experience Framework team that builds the platform powering ServiceNow's AI-first user interfaces - an SSR runtime (karuna) built on Lit and server-rendered web components, running behind a multi-tier proxy/HTTP2 routing chain with sharded V8 isolate pools, paired with a ServiceNow Glide/Java platform layer (karuna-glide) that supplies metadata, ACLs, and service artifacts. This role owns production reliability for that stack end to end: Kubernetes deployment and operations, observability, and hands-on troubleshooting of both the Node.js and JVM sides of the system - not generalist infrastructure work.

Position – how you’ll contribute

  • Own Kubernetes deployment and operational health for Framework services, including scaling, rollout/rollback strategy, and resource tuning
  • Build and maintain production observability - Grafana dashboards and Prometheus alerting rules - across the SSR runtime and the Glide platform layer
  • Diagnose and resolve Node.js production incidents: event-loop stalls, heap growth, V8 isolate exhaustion, and isolate-pool scheduling issues under concurrent versioned traffic (vN/vN-1)
  • Diagnose and resolve JVM production incidents on the Glide/Java side: GC pressure, thread dumps, and platform-service latency
  • Own incident response for the team: runbooks, on-call rotation, postmortems, and paging hygiene
  • Drive CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code for Kubernetes manifests/Helm and deployment pipelines
  • Partner with the framework engineering team to identify reliability gaps before they become incidents - capacity planning, load testing, chaos/failure-injection where useful
  • Represent production reliability concerns in architecture reviews for new framework capabilities

Expectations – the experience you need

  • Production operations/SRE experience, including hands-on Kubernetes deployment, scaling, and incident response
  • Direct operational experience troubleshooting Node.js in production: reading heap snapshots and CPU profiles, diagnosing event-loop blocking, and understanding process/worker isolation models (V8 isolates or equivalent sandboxing)
  • Direct operational experience troubleshooting JVM-based services in production: GC log analysis, thread dump analysis, and JVM tuning
  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining Prometheus alerting rules and Grafana dashboards from scratch, not just consuming existing ones
  • Strong Linux/networking fundamentals: DNS, load balancing, TCP/HTTP semantics (including HTTP/2), and debugging service-to-service networking inside Kubernetes
  • Experience with CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code for containerized deployments (Helm, GitOps tooling such as ArgoCD/Flux, or equivalent)
  • Track record owning on-call rotations, writing runbooks, and driving postmortems that lead to real reliability improvements
  • Experience with Splunk for log aggregation, search, and production troubleshooting.
  • Hands-on experience with in-memory caching systems (Valkey/Redis) in production — key design, TTL/eviction tuning, and tenant-scoped cache invalidation
  • Experience managing service-to-service mTLS - certificate issuance, rotation, and format conversion (e.g., PKCS/BCFKS↔PEM) - plus JWT-based service authentication
  • Very good spoken and written English.

Additional skills – the edge you have

  • Familiarity with server-side rendering architectures and the specific failure modes of isomorphic runtimes (markup mismatches, browser-API leakage into server code)
  • Experience operating multi-version/canary rollout strategies (two live app versions served concurrently)
  • Working knowledge of the ServiceNow Glide platform or a comparable enterprise platform integration layer
  • Experience with distributed tracing and request-context correlation across service boundaries
  • Familiarity with event-driven autoscaling (e.g., KEDA ScaledObjects driven by PromQL triggers) as a complement to standard HPA-based scaling

Our offer – professional development, personal growth:

  • Flexible employment and remote work
  • International projects with leading global clients
  • International business trips
  • Non-corporate atmosphere
  • Language classes
  • Internal & external training
  • Private healthcare and insurance

title: Quantum Information Science Postdoc
description:
Brookhaven Lab’s Computing and Data Sciences directorate (CDS) is accelerating computing and domain science by providing a complete ecosystem that safely and seamlessly provides the expertise, compute and data resources, and research environment to drive discovery.

CDS employs a multidisciplinary, collaborative approach to its applied math, artificial intelligence, and computing research and uses broad capabilities to target scientific challenges, working with fellow researchers at the Lab and many global partners.

The focus of this position is mainly on designing new topological quantum error correcting codes and analyzing their properties. We are also interested in quantum algorithm / quantum code co-design, as well as code design for specific hardware architectures.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

We are looking for a postdoctoral research associate who can collaborate closely with the PI on projects related to topological quantum error correcting codes. The work is theoretical, mainly consisting of devising and using mathematical tools for analysis and varying degrees of coding for testing ideas.

Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Ph.D. in Theoretical Physics, Mathematics or Computer Science within the last 5 years.

  • Research experience in quantum information science, particularly quantum error correcting codes.

  • Candidates must have excellent written and oral communication skills, be self-motivated and able to work both independently and as a part of a team.

  • Ability to interact effectively and work closely with the PI and collaborators.

  • Proven ability to disseminate research results by writing manuscripts and giving academic presentations.

  • Candidates must be interested in quantum error correcting codes, and algorithm / code codesign.

  • Aptitude for analytical work and ability to code efficiently.

Preferred Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Familiarity with topological codes

  • Expertise in tensor networks

  • Expertise in training Artificial Intelligence (AI) models, in particular graph neural networks.

  • Familiarity with high-performance computing.

Environmental, Health & Safety Requirements:

  • Demonstrated commitment to working safely, acting ethically, and taking personal accountability for operational excellence.

Other Information:

  • This is a fully remote position with the option to be onsite

  • This position has an initial 1-year term, with the possibility of renewal contingent on performance and funding availability.

  • BNL policy requires that after obtaining a PhD, eligible candidates for research associate appointments may not exceed a combined total of 5 years of relevant work experience as a post-doc and/or in an R&D position, excluding time associated with family planning, military service, illness or other life-changing events.

  • Candidates must have received a Ph.D. by the commencement of employment.

Not only will you be required to oversee all dishes from start to finish, you are also tasked with hiring and firing employees, meeting health and safety standards and dreaming up new recipes for the restaurant you work in.

If you love to cook, enjoy being creative and relish the challenges that come with responsibility, read on to learn more about becoming a head chef.

A candidate who wants to become a head chef must acquire on the job training which is most important for career progress and advancement in the path of becoming a head chef.

A head chef must possess a lot of stamina and will power to be able to stand for long hours and work for extended hours too in order to experiment in creating new dishes.

The candidate should also possess good knowledge of food products and their availability in order to plan cuisine accordingly.

A head chef should have good organizing, supervising and time management skills to be able to oversee all the activities that take place in the kitchen in a proper manner.

description:
Dialogue is the #1 virtual care provider in Canada. By developing our Integrated Health Platform, we provide exceptional online health and wellness programs (primary care, mental health, iCBT, EAP, and wellness) to organizations that want to improve the wellness of their employees and families.

When it comes to our work, we set the bar high. Together, we’re transforming health and helping millions improve their well‑being. We’re firm believers that great people don’t settle on:

  • Impact
  • Community
  • Growth

Come as you are. As a proud equal‑opportunity employer, Dialogue is dedicated to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace for everyone. Qualified applicants will be considered regardless of citizenship, ethnicity, race, colour, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, disability, age, or veteran status. Applicants who require specialized accommodation are encouraged to contact accessibility@dialogue.co .

AI Disclosure Statement

To ensure an efficient and fair review process, we utilize artificial intelligence tools to assist in the initial screening and assessment of applicants for this role.

Dialogue only contacts candidates through official @dialogue.co email addresses. We never request payment, gift cards, or personal financial information at any stage of hiring, and we never extend an offer without a structured interview process. All open roles are listed exclusively at dialogue.co/en/careers. If you receive a suspicious communication claiming to be from Dialogue, do not respond — report it to jobs@dialogue.co and verify the role on our official careers page.

Your role asData Developer

We are seeking a Data Developer to join Dialogue’s Client Stream team. You will be a key contributor to the technical implementation of our client‑facing data pipelines, powering the systems that enable seamless data integration with large partners so that we can monitor and improve patient care across every Canadian jurisdiction.

This role sits at the intersection of data engineering, data governance, and backend productionization. You will be responsible for building and maintaining the pipelines that allow our team to share anonymized, curated datasets with partners, enabling continuous monitoring of product performance, real‑time eligibility management, and reimbursement processing. These systems make our product better, offer faster care to our members, and reduce out‑of‑pocket costs for them.

What you’ll be doing

  • As a Data Developer, you will serve as the bridge between backend development, data analytics, and client operations, ensuring that data‑sharing workflows are reliable, observable, and production‑ready.

You will design and maintain the pipelines, data architectures, and tooling that enables reliability and flexibility, strong data governance, and continuous improvement of our client data‑sharing capabilities.

Day‑to‑day you will:

  • Build and maintain data pipelines in Snowflake using dbt for transformation and Airflow for orchestration, ensuring data flows reliably from source systems to partner‑facing datasets.
  • Design and maintain data models in dbt across staging, intermediate, and mart layers, transforming raw source data into curated, well‑documented datasets ready for partner consumption and SOW reporting and data products.
  • Design and implement Snowflake Secure Data Sharing configurations to provide partners with governed and anonymized data.
  • Develop and own batch and event‑driven data pipelines (Snowpipe, EventBridge) that power eligibility management, engagement reporting, and care reimbursement.
  • Implement robust observability for data pipelines—structured logging, data quality checks, freshness monitoring, and alerting—to ensure shared data is accurate and delivered on schedule.
  • Manage data infrastructure as code using Terraform (Snowflake roles, warehouses, schemas, and access policies), ensuring reproducibility and auditability.
  • Collaborate with data analysts to define and validate reporting metrics (engagement volume, conversion rates, bounce rates) against requirements, ensuring data accuracy before it reaches partners.
  • Champion data governance and privacy practices, including anonymization standards, access controls, and compliance with Canadian health data regulations.

We’d love to hear from you if you have

  • Have strong experience with Snowflake (including Secure Data Sharing, Snowpipe, and role‑based access control) and dbt for data modeling and transformation.
  • Have experience with data modeling techniques (dimensional modeling, slowly changing dimensions, star schema) and building well‑structured transformation layers in dbt and Snowflake.
  • Are proficient with workflow orchestration tools such as Airflow, and comfortable building and maintaining production DAGs.
  • Bring solid software engineering fundamentals—version control (Git), CI/CD, testing, observability, and infrastructure‑as‑code (Terraform).
  • Have experience working with AWS services relevant to data pipelines (S3, EventBridge, Secrets Manager, Pinpoint or similar event streaming platforms).
  • Understand data governance, anonymization techniques, and the sensitivity required when handling health data in a regulated environment.
  • Are comfortable collaborating closely with data analysts, developers, and operational stakeholders in a cross‑functional product environment.
  • Care about reliability and correctness as much as velocity, and enjoy building systems that are simple, maintainable, and measurable.
  • Thrive in environments where your work directly powers real‑world operational decisions and partner‑facing commitments.

At Dialogue, your well‑being is our priority

Taking care of others also means taking care of our team! Depending on your role and employment status , you could have access to the following benefits:

  • Access to the Dialogue app and virtual mental health support for you and your family
  • Fully funded insurance, a health spending account, dental coverage, and fitness reimbursement
  • 4 weeks vacation, 9 wellness days, and 1 volunteer day
  • Hybrid work: 3 days/week in our Montreal or Toronto offices, excluding remote roles
  • Work abroad up to 4 weeks/year
  • Incentive plans, referral bonuses & RRSP matching
  • Learning via Coursera, external training budget & mentorship

title: Lead Information Security Analyst, GRC
description:
For over four decades, Cirrus Logic has been propelled by the top engineers in mixed-signal processing. Our rockstar team thrives on solving complex challenges with innovative end-user solutions for the world's top consumer brands. Cirrus Logic is also known for its award-winning culture, built on a foundation of inclusion and fairness, meaningful community engagement, and delivering enjoyable employee experiences at every turn. But we couldn’t do it without our extraordinary workforce – and that’s where you come in. Join our team and help us continue to make Cirrus Logic an exceptional place to grow your career!

We are seeking a highly motivated, experienced professional to join the Cirrus Logic Information Security team as a Lead Information Security Analyst - Governance, Risk Management, & Compliance (GRC).

You will be responsible for designing, operating, and continually improving our ISO 27001–aligned governance, risk, and compliance program, with a strong focus on Integrated Risk Management, Third Party Risk Management, and security control effectiveness. You will also help define, refine, and operationalise the responsible use of AI technologies and services (including GenAI and Agentic AI) across the enterprise from a security and risk perspective. This role is highly collaborative and supports business strategy in a dynamic, engineering driven environment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • GRC Program & ISO 27001: Lead day‑to‑day operation and continuous improvement of our ISO 27001–aligned Information Security Management System (ISMS), including policies, standards, and control procedures across the organization.

  • Policy, Standards, and Exception Management: Develop, maintain, and socialise information security policies, standards, and guidelines; manage exceptions, ensuring decisions are risk‑based, documented, and periodically reviewed.

  • Integrated Risk Management: Lead security risk and control assessments for new systems, services, and business initiatives, partnering with Security, IT, and business owners to identify threats, evaluate the design and operating effectiveness of controls, and document and track risk treatment plans. This includes evaluating AI/ML use cases (internal builds and third-party services) for security, data protection, and misuse risks.

  • Third‑Party Risk Management: Plan and execute third‑party risk assessments for suppliers and service providers, including review of third-party security questionnaires, trust documents, and remediation plans to ensure third-party security meets Cirrus Logic’s requirements.

  • Risk Analysis & Reporting: Analyze risks across technologies and business processes, prioritize remediation efforts based on business impact and likelihood, and prepare clear risk and control status reports for security leadership and key stakeholders.

  • GRC Tooling & Automation: Configure, administer, and optimize GRC tooling, such as ServiceNow GRC or OneTrust GRC, to support risk registers, control libraries, assessments, exceptions, and third-party workflows, including integration with IT and security platforms where appropriate.

  • Audit & Assessment Support: Coordinate and provide evidence for internal and external audits, customer security assessments, and certifications (e.g., ISO 27001, SOC‑related reviews), ensuring consistent, high‑quality responses.

  • Privacy & Regulatory Support: Partner with Legal, HR, and other stakeholders to identify and manage security‑related privacy and regulatory obligations; support privacy risk assessments and data protection controls as needed. Work with these stakeholders to assess privacy and data protection implications of AI/ML solutions, including data ingestion, training, and model outputs.

  • AI Risk & Governance: Define and maintain security and risk guardrails for the use of AI/ML technologies, including acceptable-use guidelines, control requirements, and review processes for new AI use cases and vendors.

  • Collaboration & Enablement: Act as a trusted advisor to the team members, IT, and business teams, helping translate security and risk requirements into practical, implementable solutions that align with engineering and operational realities. Partner closely with IT, engineering, and business teams to embed security, risk, and governance requirements into AI solution design and operations. Work effectively with a globally dispersed team across various time zones that Cirrus operates in.

  • Communication, Executive Presence & Awareness: Strong executive presence with outstanding written, verbal, and presentation skills. Ability to communicate complex risk, control, compliance, and program matters clearly and credibly to technical teams, business stakeholders, and executive leadership. Proven capability to develop high-quality executive-ready content, including presentations, briefings, and status updates that drive informed decision-making. Support and contribute to GRC awareness, communications, and training initiatives, including targeted awareness on the secure and responsible use of authorised AI tools.

Required Skills and Qualifications:

  • Proven experience in Information Security with a strong focus on GRC, risk management, and/or security compliance in a global environment.

  • Bachelor’s degree in cybersecurity, information systems, or a related field, or demonstrated equivalent experience as a security professional in a globally dispersed enterprise.

  • Hands‑on experience with ISO/IEC 27001 (ISMS lifecycle, Annex A controls, risk assessment and treatment) and related security control frameworks (e.g., NIST CSF, ISO 27000, TISAX, etc.).

  • Demonstrated experience with Integration Risk Management (project/solution risk assessments) and Third‑Party Risk Management (vendor due diligence, ongoing monitoring, and remediation).

  • Technical fluency across core IT and security domains (e.g., network, endpoint, identity, cloud/SaaS, logging/monitoring) and experience working with Security Engineering, Security Operations, and IT teams.

  • Experience configuring and maintaining an enterprise-grade GRC platform, preferably ServiceNow GRC, for risk, control, assessment, and exception workflows.

  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills, with the ability to balance security, compliance, and business objectives in a practical way.

  • Effective communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to clearly convey risk and technical issues to both technical and non‑technical stakeholders, including senior leaders.

  • Proven ability to drive work independently, manage multiple concurrent initiatives, and follow through to completion in a fast‑paced environment.

  • Experience working in high‑tech, engineering, or semiconductor environments is beneficial.

  • Relevant certifications (e.g., ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Lead Auditor, CISSP, CISM, CISA, CRISC) are preferred but not required.

This position is based in our Edinburgh office. It is a hybrid role (minimum 2+ days onsite) with the flexibility to work from home, depending on business needs. Candidates must live within a commutable distance or be willing to relocate.

title: Senior Consultant, Boiler Inspector
description:
Description

Advance your career with Liberty Mutual Insurance – A Fortune 100 Company

Are you looking for an opportunity to use your degree in the business world? Then Liberty Mutual’s Equipment Breakdown Risk Control group might be right for you. Our team works closely with customers to help them identify, quantify, mitigate, or eliminate serious threats to their businesses. In the process, we help fulfill Liberty Mutual’s mission of helping people live safer, more secure lives.

Liberty Mutual is currently hiring an Equipment Breakdown Risk Control Consultant to provide jurisdictionally required inspections and other services to an assigned group of customers.

This role is 100% remote within the assigned territory. This role is also eligible for a company car. Additional information will be provided if you moved forward to speak with a recruiter.

The role provides commercial lines customers with boiler and pressure vessel inspections services through the successful completion of an entry-level training program and experience. Conducts extensive research, data collection and evaluation and analysis in order to make recommendations to control customer's source of risk, loss and/or costs.

This position is a remote, home-based and field role; however, candidates must reside within the designated territory. Preferred locations include Western Massachusetts and the Capital Region of New York, including Albany and Troy. Residency within or near the assigned territory is strongly preferred to support business operations, customer engagement, and regional travel requirements as needed.

This position may be filled at various levels, commensurate with the candidate’s qualifications and possession of an NBIC Commission. Candidates who do not yet have an IS Commission are considered at a trainee level. The role involves a hybrid work arrangement, combining remote responsibilities with field-based activities. The Risk Control team operates in a collaborative environment, working virtually across multiple target territories to support operational objectives.

Reporting to the Equipment Breakdown Engineering Manager, you will:

  • Perform internal and external inspections of boilers, pressure vessels, steam and hot water systems, combustion equipment and associated piping and controls.
  • Conduct non destructive testing (ultrasonic thickness, magnetic particle, dye penetrant) and verify results.
  • Evaluate combustion efficiency, flue gas conditions and burner operation where applicable.
  • Assess water treatment and chemistry records and advise on corrosion or scaling risks.
  • Verify compliance with applicable codes, standards and regulations (e.g., ASME Boiler & Pressure Vessel Code, NBIC, and local/state requirements).
  • Prepare clear, accurate inspection reports, deficiency notices and certificates of inspection.
  • Recommend and document required repairs or modifications, and inspect completed repairs for compliance.
  • Coordinate inspections with owners, contractors and regulatory authorities.
  • Stay current on code updates, inspection techniques and industry best practices.
  • Exposure to noise, heat, confined spaces, and industrial environments; use of personal protective equipment required.
  • After hours or emergency inspections may be required.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent with coursework in mathematics and engineering or related area, plus a minimum of 3 years of directly related consulting experience.
  • NBBI IS Commission or ability to obtain NBBI IS Commission.
  • Demonstrated ability to retrieve and enter information using various proprietary software applications and create/modify documents and spreadsheets using Microsoft Office suite.
  • Knowledge, skills, and experience in boiler and pressure vessel inspections, service planning and delivery, risk assessment, risk analysis, solutions management, and progress measurement.
  • Fully effective interpersonal, writing, and other communication skills required to develop and maintain relationships with customers, peers, and industry contacts.
  • Ability to work closely with Claims and Underwriting.
  • Position requires regular travel.

description:

Daikin Middle East & Africa is a subsidiary of Daikin Industries Ltd. and the leading provider of heating, cooling, ventilation, air purification, and refrigeration technology. The company designs, manufactures and brings to market a broad portfolio of equipment, as well as tailor‑made solutions for residential, commercial, and industrial purposes in Europe, Middle East, and Africa (EMEA). To date, Daikin EMEA has over 12 000 employees across more than 59 consolidated subsidiaries. It has 12 major manufacturing facilities based in Belgium, the Czech Republic, Germany, Italy, Spain, Turkey, Austria, and the UK. Our aim is to drive sustainable and effective solutions, sparking a good climate for the generations to come. And all this can only be achieved because of our People.

About the Role

The Application Engineer – DX & VRV plays a key role in delivering technically sound, optimized, and commercially competitive HVAC solutions across Daikin's sales organization. This role is responsible for equipment selection, system design validation, technical compliance, and application engineering support throughout the project lifecycle. You will work closely with Sales, Product Management, Engineering, and other internal stakeholders, and ensure that proposed DX and VRV solutions meet customer requirements, local regulations, and Daikin engineering standards while contributing to successful project execution and business growth in Qatar. How You Will Make an Impact Provide application engineering support to all Sales functions throughout the project lifecycle, from project inquiry to order confirmation. Design, size, and select DX, VRV and AHU equipment using Daikin selection software (VRV, AHU selection software, and other approved engineering tools). Review project specifications, tender documents, HVAC drawings, and schedules to develop compliant and optimized technical solutions. Validate equipment selections to ensure technical feasibility, energy efficiency, compliance with project requirements, and adherence to Daikin engineering standards. Prepare technical submittals, equipment schedules, selection reports, and engineering documentation to support project proposals. Provide value engineering recommendations and alternative solutions that improve technical performance and commercial competitiveness. Coordinate with Product Management, Sales, Factory Engineering, and other internal teams to resolve technical queries and ensure timely project support. Support quotation preparation by providing accurate technical selections, engineering calculations, and costing inputs. Participate in technical meetings with consultants, customers, contractors, and internal stakeholders to present solutions, discuss design requirements, and address application-related questions. Stay current with HVAC technologies, local regulations, industry standards, and Daikin product developments to provide best in class application support. Ensure smooth technical handover to the execution team following order confirmation. What You Need to Succeed Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, HVAC Engineering, or a related engineering discipline. Minimum 5 years of experience in HVAC Application Engineering, Technical Support, or HVAC System Design, with strong expertise in DX and VRV systems, preferably within the Qatar or GCC market. Strong knowledge of HVAC system design, equipment selection, psychometrics, heat load calculations, and energy‑efficient system applications. Hands‑on experience using HVAC selection and design software, including VRV, Auto CAD, AHU selection software and Microsoft Office applications. Solid understanding of MEP drawings, HVAC design standards, tender specifications, and consultant requirements. Proven experience providing technical support across multiple sales channels, including equipment selection, solution optimization, value engineering, and technical proposal development. Ability to analyze project requirements, identify technical risks, and recommend practical engineering solutions. Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to build effective relationships with consultants, contractors, customers, and internal stakeholders. Excellent planning, organizational, and problem‑solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and meet tight deadlines. Fluent in English. Arabic language skills are an advantage. Knowledge of international HVAC standards (ASHRAE and AHRI) and familiarity with the Qatar Construction Specifications (QCS) and other applicable local regulations will be an advantage. The TeamViewer ONE platform finds and resolves IT issues before they affect users. Over the past several years we have successfully built and released products which make IT administrators' day-to-day life easier. Our vision is to become a unified endpoint management solution for our customers.

We’re looking for a Staff Software Engineer to play a key role in supporting and enhancing our TeamViewer ONE and Remote Management capabilities, trusted by small and medium business customers. In this role, you’ll be essential to maintaining and improving the experience for our existing customers, while helping evolve our SaaS cloud platform. You will also bring in expertise in using technologies – C++, Jenkins, Salt, SQL, Cassandra, and Containerization.

As part of an agile team, you’ll contribute as an individual contributor, working primarily with C++, C# and SQL to enhance our Patch Management product in the context of TeamViewer ONE. You will be expected to guide other team members of the team in best practices in software development. Build services for our TeamViewer ONE & Remote Management solution, by enabling the platform and clients to protect our customers

  • Define the architecture, design and develop new features for our software in C++

  • Collaborate with front-end engineers, backend engineers and quality assurance engineers to design optimum solutions, balancing performance, costs and long-term maintainability

  • Continuously integrate, build and deploy our solution from test system to production

  • Contribute to our clients, backend services and partner APIs

  • A positive and solution-oriented mindset paired with a structured and analytical way of thinking/working, being a team player, as well as motivated to learn new things

title: Test Automaton Engineer
description:
Description

Test Automation Engineer

Location: Farnborough, UK

Security Clearance Level: DV

UNLEASH YOUR POTENTIAL

Leidos is seeking a Test Automation Engineer to join its UK team in the Farnborough area. The role will support the delivery of secure, reliable technical solutions through a combination of manual testing, Python-based test automation, AWS and database expertise. The successful candidate will be a seasoned technical individual contributor who is fully proficient in applying testing principles, theories and concepts, and who can work independently on technically difficult or unclear problems.

Everything we do is built on a commitment to do the right thing for our customers, our people and our community. Our mission and our values guide the way we do business. The foundation of our Leidos culture is our Values, Beliefs and Expectations by which we select, recognise and reward employees. They create the environment that drives us toward our mission.

Inspired to make a difference, we are committed to solving the world’s toughest problems.

Are you ready for your next challenge?

Come join our team and further develop your skills as we deliver and support systems key to the defence of the UK and partner nations. Being part of the Leidos team is a commitment to push yourself and those around you to do better, constantly adapt and learn new technologies. We’re a passionate team and are committed to developing and growing our staff. Leidos is a global science and technology solutions leader working to solve the world's toughest challenges in defence, intelligence, homeland security, civil, and health markets. The company's 33,000 employees support vital missions for government and commercial customers.

Your Key Role and Responsibilities

  • Define, develop, execute and maintain manual and automated test approaches across functional, integration, system and regression testing.

  • Design and implement scalable Python test automation frameworks, reusable libraries and supporting utilities.

  • Test AWS-hosted services and applications, including interfaces, data flows, permissions, logging and operational behaviour.

  • Plan and perform security testing against applicable CIS Security Controls and Safeguards, confirming that required controls are implemented, configured correctly and supported by suitable evidence.

  • Assess security controls across AWS, applications, databases and supporting infrastructure, including secure configuration, identity and access management, vulnerability management, audit logging, data protection, network monitoring and application security.

  • Document security test plans, control-to-test traceability, findings, evidence, residual risks and remediation recommendations, and verify corrective actions through retesting.

  • Validate relational and/or non-relational databases through data interrogation, reconciliation, integrity checks and backend testing.

  • Analyse requirements, designs and acceptance criteria to determine test coverage, traceability and risk-based priorities.

  • Investigate failures, identify root causes, record high-quality defects and collaborate with engineering teams through resolution and retest.

  • Produce clear test plans, test cases, automation assets, evidence, results and completion reports.

  • Support estimation, planning, technical reviews and continuous improvement of test practices, tooling and quality controls.

  • Provide technical guidance, coaching and constructive review to less experienced technical staff.

  • Communicate technical findings, risks and recommendations to internal stakeholders, project leaders and client team members.

Your skills and experience

  • Strong practical experience of manual testing, including test analysis, design, execution, defect management and reporting.

  • Proven experience creating and maintaining automated tests using Python.

  • Hands-on experience testing applications or services hosted in AWS.

  • Practical security testing experience focused on assessing CIS Security Controls and Safeguards, including the ability to translate control requirements into measurable test cases and evidence-based findings.

  • Experience testing security controls within cloud and hybrid environments, with particular attention to secure configuration, access control, logging, vulnerability management, data protection and application security.

  • Strong database testing skills, including the use of SQL for data validation and fault investigation.

  • Ability to develop solutions to difficult or unclear technical testing problems through deep analysis and collaboration with internal experts.

  • Deep understanding of software testing principles, test techniques, quality risks and the software development lifecycle.

  • Broad awareness of related engineering disciplines, including software development, infrastructure, security and deployment practices.

  • Experience working independently and taking ownership of complete testing projects or processes within a technical area.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence project and team leaders on test design, process and technical approach.

Desirable Skills

  • Experience integrating automated tests into continuous integration and continuous delivery/deployment (CI/CD) pipelines.

  • Experience using Selenium for browser-based test automation.

  • Proficiency with Git-based version control, branching, pull requests and peer review.

  • Experience with API testing, test doubles, service virtualisation or performance testing.

  • Familiarity with containerised environments and infrastructure-as-code delivery practices.

  • Experience working within Agile delivery teams.

Career-Level Requirements

  • Operate as a seasoned technical individual contributor, fully proficient in applying technical principles, theories and concepts within the testing discipline.
