title: Avionics Software Engineer
description:
About Lodestar

Lodestar's mission is to develop the first "Protect and Defend" capability for high-value space assets in orbit. Our flagship product, MITHRIL, is our hardware-agnostic, AI-enabled autonomy software suite that enables us to augment any off-the-shelf spacecraft with the ability to autonomously detect, characterise, and reversibly neutralise orbital threats. By building on the proven space heritage of our best-in-class satellite-bus partners and fully integrating MITHRIL into a single unified platform, we deliver an end-to-end, autonomous in-space bodyguarding service.

About the Job

We’re hiring Avionics Software Engineers across three technical focus areas: Flight Software, Distributed Middleware & Embedded Linux Depending on your experience, you’ll take ownership of one of these areas while working closely across avionics, autonomy, AI/ML, and hardware.

What You'll Do

Within our Avionics Software team, we're hiring multiple engineers across three core technical specialisms. Please identify which role best matches your skills and experience:

1. Flight Software Engineering

  • Design and develop deterministic, safety-critical, fault tolerant flight software for autonomous spacecraft.
  • Build robust software for RTOS-based flight computers, implementing FDIR and defensive programming techniques.
  • Collaborate with autonomy, AI, and hardware engineers to integrate, test, and validate mission-critical software on representative spacecraft platforms.

2. Distributed Middleware Engineering

  • Develop the distributed middleware enabling communication, workload orchestration, and telemetry across heterogeneous onboard compute systems.
  • Build resilient software infrastructure including high-performance IPC, networking, process supervision, and fail-safe Over-The-Air (OTA) update mechanisms.
  • Deliver scalable software platforms that support fault-tolerant autonomous operations.

3. Embedded Linux Engineering

  • Develop and maintain custom embedded Linux platforms for NVIDIA Jetson-based flight computers, from board bring-up through to deployment.
  • Optimise kernel performance through real-time tuning, low-level driver development, system profiling and selective kernel slimming.
  • Architect a hardened, minimal-footprint Linux-based operating system.

Qualifications

The following qualifications are desired across all three roles:

  • BEng/MEng in Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent experience.
  • Strong foundation in C++.
  • Experience developing software for embedded systems using Linux or RTOS (e.g., RTEMS, FreeRTOS).
  • Solid understanding of multi-process architectures and inter-process communication.
  • Strong communicator and self-starter; able to work independently and in a collaborative team.
  • Demonstrated skills in debugging and performance characterisation.

Preferred Skills & Experience

Desired skills and experience relevant to the three roles:

  • Good understanding of communication protocols.
  • Familiarity with containerisation and deployment tools (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Deep understanding of Linux kernel architecture, bootloaders (e.g., U-Boot), and low-level system bring-up.
  • Understanding of fault-tolerant design principles, error handling, or defensive programming in resource-constrained systems.
  • Experience with real-time Linux kernel tuning.
  • Background with the space industry.
  • Experience with publish-subscribe middlewares.
  • Exposure to fail-safe Over-The-Air (OTA) update frameworks.
  • Demonstrated strong problem-solving skills and ability to work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proven experience in system integration and working with multidisciplinary teams.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Pay Range:
    • (E1) Junior Engineer: £30,000 - £55,000 / year
    • (E2) Mid-level Engineer: £55,000 - £75,000 / year
  • Meaningful equity incentives as part of our employee option pool
  • 28 Days Annual Leave
  • Comprehensive medical, dental & vision coverage
  • Contributory pension
  • Be part of a scrappy, dynamic, multidisciplinary, collaborative crew 🏴‍☠️

Important Information:

For security reasons background checks will be undertaken prior to any employment offers being made to an applicant. These checks will include nationality checks as it is a requirement of this position that you be eligible to access equipment and data regulated by the United States' International Traffic in Arms Regulations.

Lead UX/UI Designer

Team: Game Studio

Commitment: Full-Time

Salary:

Final compensation will be determined based on factors such as experience, skills, and qualifications. In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for performance-based bonuses and equity awards.

Worldscape is a cutting-edge platform designed to unify distributed data, sensors, and intelligent agents across cloud, on-prem, and edge environments. By combining geospatial intelligence, physics-based 3D simulation, and reward-driven AI, Worldscape enables organizations to build immersive digital twins for predictive modeling, scenario planning, and adaptive decision-making. With a zero-trust security framework, seamless integration with legacy systems, and robust developer tools, Worldscape empowers rapid deployment of agentic applications that drive resilience and efficiency in sectors like logistics, telecom, defense, and infrastructure.

Worldscape is seeking a Lead UX/UI Designer to join our fast-moving, innovative Studio team. In this role you will drive the definition and design for Worldscape's client simulation design framework capabilities. The design system provides the components used throughout the client, website, and mobile app for user experience and operation. As part of our studio team, you’ll contribute to a diverse and successful set of live projects, help define the design of new projects, and collaborate with our cross-functional, world-class team to deliver intuitive and delightful experiences and contribute to the success of the studio.
Working directly with customers and cross-functional teams, you’ll design wireframes, user flows, UI components, and interactive prototypes translating ideas into visually compelling, user-centric interfaces that move from concept to reality.
This is an onsite role that will be located in Redmond, WA.

Responsibilities:

  • Identify, create, and optimize design foundations, reusable components, and high-level patterns for the Worldscape client application that are driven by customer objectives.
  • Identify opportunities for innovation and lead exploratory design initiatives, bringing design thinking methodology across the studio team.
  • Deliver artifacts that raise the bar for visual and user experience design, whether you're working on wireframes, user flows, high-fidelity mockups, or prototypes.
  • Partner with a multi-disciplinary product and engineering team to own the implementation of your work.
  • Collaborate with designers, engineers, and other stakeholders across teams and organizations to increase adoption and shape the future of our design system.
  • Create and optimize the processes and tools available to our designers, developers, and other consumers to collaborate.
  • Partner with our platform, Product, Engineering, and Marketing teams to create a consistent cross device customer and user experience
  • Establish and evolve design standards and best practices

Professional Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in HCI, Interaction Design, Graphic Design, or equivalent design-related field; or commensurate experience.
  • 8+ years of UX design or interaction design experience.
  • 8+ years of design experience creating mockups, wireframes and prototypes for web and mobile applications and/or workflows.
  • Experience using tools such as Figma for prototyping design concepts and for defining and documenting the user interface architecture (UI patterns, components and guidelines).
  • Proficient in establishing, designing, and using design systems and design frameworks.
  • Have an available online portfolio demonstrating samples of design deliverables (design systems, personas, journey maps, wireframes, and prototypes)
  • Experience with agile development methodologies

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience is game design and understanding how design impacts the overall player experience.
  • Experience with emerging technologies (AR/VR, AI/ML).
  • 5+ years creating designs and using design systems in Figma, preferably across multiple screen sizes.
  • 3+ years prototyping in Figma, Framer, or equivalent software.
  • Experience participating in the complete product development lifecycle of successfully launched games/applications.
  • Ability to prototype in environments like HTML, JavaScript, and CSS a plus but not required.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and make an impact in a fast-paced environment.
  • Adobe Creative Cloud experience (Photoshop, Illustrator, or similar) a plus.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills and the ability to articulate the rationale behind your design decisions.
  • Experience in delivering design solutions for projects of large scope and complexity and a track record of leading design projects that have launched.
Why Worldscape?
There is nothing more important to Worldscape than our culture. It is the fundamental means by which we will succeed as an organization. Talent, ability, drive, experience, knowledge cannot be maximized without first embracing the culture we espouse and will live every single day. Worldscape offers great benefits, opportunities for continued growth, and the ability to directly affect change in our organization and be part of a high-growth startup at a pivotal stage.

title: Product Engineer
description:
Capi is building the financial infrastructure for emerging markets trade.

Our mission is to grow GDP in emerging markets by making the global financial system fairer and more accessible. We’re tackling global trade, making it easier for importers to pay their international suppliers. Our platform enables businesses to expand rapidly, create jobs, and be engines of prosperity for their countries.

Our team is made up of approx 100 people across 10 countries; we are a group of a highly-ambitious, get-it-done people, who like to work hard on something that has a tangible impact in the world. And we’re looking for more people to join our team!

Take a look through Capi’s mission & values.

Role Overview

You’ll join a small, high-performing team of engineers and product leaders shaping how we scale our platform and our impact.

We have around 15 engineers, led by Head of Engineering, split across 3 teams Atlas, Blue Nile & Caprivi. Each lead by one of our Staff engineers who set architectural direction and Senior engineers who each bring a distinct spike rather than filling a generic seat. Low-ego, first-principles culture - "strong opinions, weakly held" - building the infrastructure that moves cross-border payments across multiple African jurisdictions, reliably and at real scale.

From your first day, you will have the opportunity to work closely with the founding team based across London & Paris to shape the product vision and all parts of our technical architecture. As we scale our products and deepen our presence across emerging markets, this is a role that builds technology to solve customer problems.

To do that, you must have empathy and curiosity to get to the root cause of the issue and the creativity to build a solution that balances impact, effort, and delight.

Key Responsibilities

Delivery

  • Contribute to the product process from end-to-end, from ideation to building the UI, backend logic, deployment, feedback and measurement

  • Communicate internally and externally about new features, be it collecting feedback pre-implementation or explaining them on launch

  • Define and manage delivery milestones, ensuring alignment between engineering and product priorities

Technical

  • Build intuitive and performant web interfaces for business owners in Africa

  • Implement IT security and data protection best practices in a regulated environment

  • Proactively drive architectural decisions e.g., improving scalability, observability, and modularity of the codebase

  • Champion code quality through robust testing, documentation, and reviews

Operational

  • Observe opportunities for improvements internally to help automate our non-tech processes and add to our tech best practices to improve our output and efficiency. Including handling production incidents with confidence

Leadership

  • Mentor junior engineers and contribute to their professional growth through pairing, reviews, and feedback

  • Represent engineering in cross-functional discussions (including Finance, Operations, Senior Leadership) to help translate business goals into technical plans

  • Set and uphold team standards for communication, collaboration, and technical excellence

Culture

  • Communicate internally and externally about new features, be it collecting feedback pre-implementation or explaining them on launch

Requirements

Our tech stack: Typescript, React, NextJS, NodeJS, Express, PostgreSQL

  • A product mindset is core to how we build - everyone at Capi is encouraged to think about the customer, the business, and the long-term impact of what we ship.

  • A strong understanding of web development, frontend and backend best practices. While mainly working with JavaScript technologies

  • Experience in a VC-backed or high-growth engineering team and building products used by customers.

  • You are comfortable working in an early-stage startup environment with high pace, rapid growth, involvement in the entire product development process, and a high degree of ambiguity

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills for expressing ideas, designs, and potential solutions with both technical and non-technical team members and customers

  • You care about our mission and solving the problems faced by African businesses

  • Based in London or Paris

Bonus points if you:

  • Speak and write in French & English

  • Experience in Fintech, payments, wallets or building ledgers

  • Expertise in security and data protection best practices needed in a FCA regulated business

Some projects the team has been working on:

  • Automated payouts and AI invoice approval

  • Onboarding + payment automation with Swift network and banking partners across the world

  • WhatsApp bot that creates quotes for customers based on their responses

  • Self-serve onboarding flow that collects company information and KYC documents from customers

  • Asynchronous workers that OCR invoices

  • Internal tooling to manage and process millions of dollars of transactions

What to expect when interviewing with Capi?

Our interview process includes:

  1. Screen interview with our Tech Recruiter Gracie (30 mins) - Learn about the Capi story and mission. Whilst ensuring we are aligned as an exciting opportunity for what you're looking for

  2. Technical challenge with one of our Staff Engineers (1 hr) - Demonstrate your abilities in a whiteboard-style interview with one of our senior team members. We like to keep this as natural as possible, as if you were joining us tomorrow. This interview is to assess your skills, interests, and potential to see the impact you could make. While also ensuring Capi can support your growth

  3. Deep dive (1 hr) - Meet the hiring manager (Head of Engineering) and explore your relevant experience and our upcoming projects

  4. Founder chat (30 mins) - Meet one of the founders to learn about Capi's growth plans, mission, and revenue targets. This is also your opportunity to ask any final questions to make sure our journey is right for you.

  5. References

  6. Offer!

Additional Information

  • This is a full-time position with competitive salary, share options, and benefits

  • Ideal Start date: Nov 2026 (we are aware that a notice period may need to be fulfilled and can adjust accordingly)

Capi is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes candidates from diverse backgrounds. We’re all about building a diverse, inclusive team at Capi. Whoever you are, we’d love to hear from you. Enterprise Strategy & Innovation (ES&I) is a corporate organization that reports directly into Liberty Mutual’s Executive Leadership Team within Liberty Mutual Insurance, a Fortune 100 company with 40,000 employees in 900 offices worldwide.

The function is comprised of five interrelated verticals: Liberty’s award winning in-house enterprise strategy / strategy consulting arm (Corporate Strategy & Research), a strategic alignment group (LMG Alignment), a global innovation incubator (Solaria Labs), an enterprise venture capital group (Liberty Mutual Strategic Ventures) that invests in early-stage startups to glean critical insights on emerging disruptive trends, and a dedicated business operations team (ES&I Operations) that orchestrates the overall operating model of the ES&I function driving strategic priority setting, cross-teams alignment, business operational effectiveness, financial & performance management, and supporting culture & team engagement initiatives.

title: Maintenance Repair Worker
description:
TARGET CLOSE DATE:

08/28/2026

PAY GRADE:

Grade 16

TYPE:

Full time

JOB SUMMARY:

Maintenance Repair Workers perform a variety of specialized tasks in operating, maintaining, and repairing equipment common within buildings such as temperature control machinery, plumbing fixtures, and light fixtures. Maintenance Repair Workers commonly use tools such as wrenches, screw drivers, ladders, and multimeters to complete their daily tasks. Work assignments are received through work orders, meetings, blueprints, and verbal instruction. Maintenance Repair Workers sometimes assist Plumbers, Electricians, and Refrigeration/HVAC Technicians regarding building maintenance. The employee keeps the supervisor informed on the progress of assigned tasks.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS:

Agencies provide competitive pay and comprehensive benefits packages to include medical and dental insurance, employer-sponsored retirement plan (pension), generous paid holidays, sick and vacation leave, and more.

Applications for this position will be considered for the following Merit System employing agencies. The pay range for this job varies depending upon the Merit System employing agency.

Birmingham $17.85 - $27.69
Health Department $21.23 - $32.93
Homewood $20.62 - $31.98
Irondale $21.19 - $32.87
Jefferson County $19.83 - $30.76
Vestavia Hills $20.74 - $32.18

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

The following are job-related qualifications that are required for employment consideration for this position:

  • Driver's license.

  • Experience in routine preventive maintenance in at least two (2) of the following areas: refrigeration/HVAC, electrical, or plumbing.

TYPICAL JOB DUTIES:

  • Assists skilled trade workers with the completion of major skilled tasks by providing information about the repair, facility and problem, as well as helping with the repair process in order to accomplish the completion of the project or repair in a timely and cost-effective manner.

  • Coordinates the installation and maintenance of electrical equipment and appliances in order to maintain a safe and secure environment for employees and the public within the facility.

  • Manages the availability of necessary equipment and supplies needed for frequent repairs and maintenance so work orders can be addressed and the necessary repair or project can be accomplished correctly and on time.

  • Performs general building upkeep by identifying possible unsafe conditions and ensuring that the that need the needed repair be addressed to be resolved to maintain a safe and secure facility for the employees and public.

  • Performs general maintenance functions and minor repairs at the facility and grounds using a variety of hand tools in order to repair or replace worn or broken objects, such as handrails, doors, floors and concrete to maintain the appearance and safety of the facility.

  • Maintains and monitors the performance of heating, ventilation, air conditioning equipment, and refrigeration equipment by performing minor repairs and planned preventative maintenance to ensure the equipment is operational and producing a comfortable working environment throughout the facility.

  • Manages the maintenance, building and inspection of furniture and other facility items so that they can be safely and properly used by those at the facility and to enhance the appearance of the building.

  • Receives and processes maintenance requests from facility occupants by way of email, phone, written request or other means and acts on the request by taking ownership of the request or delegating to the appropriate party for completion so that the occupants and visitors have a safe and comfortable environment.

  • Manages the installation, repair, maintenance and the proper functioning of plumbing and water fixtures, such as faucets, toilets and sinks, using hand tools and plumbing equipment in order to ensure that the facility is safe, sanitary and useable for employees and the public.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

Job involves moderate physical exertion required for occasional prolonged periods of standing, pushing, pulling, lifting, carrying, balancing, climbing, stooping, kneeling, crouching, or crawling. Work may involve occasional lifting of items or objects weighing up to 75 lbs.

WORK ENVIRONMENT:

Work is performed within employer-owned facilities such as offices, workshops, warehouses, or stations. Work involves use of various hand tools such as screwdrivers, wrenches, and multimeters. Work requires regular exposure to live electrical circuits and hot water pipes.

title: AFSIM Modeler/Software Engineer
description:
AFSIM Modeler/Software Engineer

Team: Engineering

Location: Redmond, Washington

Commitment: Full-Time

Workplace Type: onsite

Salary:

Final compensation will be determined based on factors such as experience, skills, and qualifications. In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for performance-based bonuses and equity awards.

Worldscape is a cutting-edge platform designed to unify distributed data, sensors, and intelligent agents across cloud, on-prem, and edge environments. By combining geospatial intelligence, physics-based 3D simulation, and reward-driven AI, Worldscape enables organizations to build immersive digital twins for predictive modeling, scenario planning, and adaptive decision-making. With a zero-trust security framework, seamless integration with legacy systems, and robust developer tools, Worldscape empowers rapid deployment of agentic applications that drive resilience and efficiency in sectors like logistics, telecom, defense, and infrastructure.

We are building a breakthrough platform for next-generation geospatial intelligence and defense applications, and we're looking for an AFSIM Modeler/Software Engineer to help extend our simulation and analytics capabilities. In this role, you'll bring hands-on experience with AFSIM (Advanced Framework for Simulation, Integration, and Modeling) to help develop mission-level analytics, simulation models, and integrations within a modern software environment. You'll work at the intersection of simulation, software engineering, and aerospace systems, using your understanding of established mission modeling frameworks while helping apply that expertise to next-generation simulation environments.

This is a hands-on engineering role. We're looking for someone who enjoys writing code, solving complex technical problems, and building simulation capabilities. You don't need to be a senior defense analyst or program lead; we're looking for strong technical fundamentals and practical AFSIM experience.

Location: Redmond, WA preferred; remote candidates will be considered for the right fit.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop, configure, and maintain AFSIM models and simulation scenarios representing complex aerospace and defense systems.
  • Design and implement models for aircraft, weapons, sensors, communications, electronic warfare, and other mission systems.
  • Develop software, scripts, and tooling to extend AFSIM capabilities and automate simulation workflows.
  • Build reusable modeling components and infrastructure that can support multiple simulation scenarios and use cases.
  • Translate system requirements, technical specifications, and operational concepts into robust simulation models.
  • Integrate models and software components into larger simulation environments.
  • Run simulations, debug model behavior, investigate unexpected results, and improve model fidelity and performance.
  • Develop automated workflows for scenario generation, simulation execution, data collection, and results processing.
  • Analyze simulation outputs to validate model behavior and identify opportunities to improve the underlying implementation.
  • Collaborate closely with software engineers, systems engineers, and subject-matter experts to ensure models accurately represent real-world systems.
  • Participate in code reviews, technical design discussions, testing, and documentation.
  • Help establish best practices for AFSIM development, testing, version control, and reusable model architecture.

Professional Qualifications:

  • 2+ years of hands-on AFSIM experience, including developing or modifying models and scenarios.
  • Strong software development skills in C++, Python, or a similar programming language.
  • Experience building or working with simulation models, ideally involving aerospace, defense, robotics, autonomous systems, or other complex technical systems.
  • Ability to read and understand existing code and simulation architectures and make meaningful modifications independently.
  • Experience debugging complex software or simulation behavior and systematically identifying the underlying cause.
  • Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including version control, testing, debugging, and code quality.
  • Ability to translate real-world system behavior and technical requirements into software and simulation models.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, Operations Research, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience integrating AFSIM with other simulation, modeling, analytics, or software environments.
  • Experience developing custom AFSIM plugins, models, or extensions.
  • Experience with AFSIM's modeling architecture, interfaces, or APIs.
  • Experience with aircraft, weapons, sensors, ISR, electronic warfare, communications, or air combat systems.
  • Experience modeling crewed and uncrewed platforms.
  • Experience with simulation automation, scenario generation, Monte Carlo analysis, or large-scale simulation runs.
  • Experience with Linux-based development environments and Git.
  • Familiarity with systems engineering, mission-level analysis, or operations analysis.
  • Experience working in classified environments.
Why Worldscape?
There is nothing more important to Worldscape than our culture. It is the fundamental means by which we will succeed as an organization. Talent, ability, drive, experience, knowledge cannot be maximized without first embracing the culture we espouse and will live every single day. Worldscape offers great benefits, opportunities for continued growth, and the ability to directly affect change in our organization and be part of a high-growth startup at a pivotal stage.

What we offer:
- Competitive salary and meaningful equity
- Attractive benefits package
- Flexible time off policy
- Medical, Dental and Vision insurance
- HSA health insurance options
- 401k plan
- Basic and Voluntary Life Insurance
- Fast paced environment with flexibility and ownership
Worldscape is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, race, religion, pregnancy, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances.

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check.

title: Broista - Lancaster, CA
description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly believe in what they are doing. At Dutch Bros Coffee, we are more than just a coffee company. We are a fun-loving, mind-blowing company that makes a difference one cup at a time.

At Dutch Bros Coffee, we are a fun-loving, mind-blowing company, making a massive difference one cup at a time.

But let’s be real, this job isn’t for everyone. It’s fast, high-energy, and physically demanding. You’ll be on your feet, moving quickly, and keeping up with a steady flow of customers all while delivering next-level service. As the face of Dutch Bros, you’ll connect with customers, hustle with heart, and bring positive energy onto every single shift.

Who You Are:

  • A people person who thrives on connection and loves making someone’s day.
  • Adaptable and quick; you can handle a rush and keep the kindness rolling.
  • Team-oriented and ready to support your crew, no matter what’s needed.
  • Positive and considerate; even when it gets busy or during inclement weather you continue to show up.
  • Committed to growth and always looking for ways to improve.

What You’ll Do:

  • Engage. Greet every customer with a smile, make genuine connections, and ensure every visit is full of kindness & fun.
  • Educate. Help customers navigate the menu and discover new favorites, all while delivering top-tier service.
  • Embody. Live out the Dutch Bros values: radiate kindness, get up early, stay up late, and change the world.
  • Stay Fast & Focused. Work efficiently to craft high-quality drinks while keeping up with the hustle of a busy shop.
  • Be Reliable. Show up on time, communicate your availability, and be ready to roll when your shift starts.
  • Keep it Clean. Maintain a tidy workspace and follow food safety standards.

What to Expect:

  • Fast-paced, high-energy environment. You’ll be on your feet, moving quickly, and handling a steady flow of customers for up to 10-hour shifts!
  • Crew-first mentality. We support each other, have everyone’s backs, and get the job done together.
  • Weather-ready. Be prepared for all conditions; rain or shine. Don’t worry we’ve got Dutch gear to help!
  • Some heavy lifting. You may need to push, pull, lift, or carry up to 65 lbs (talk about a workout).
  • Reliable transportation. You’ll need to show up on time for scheduled shifts and mandatory meetings.
  • Training & Development. We’ll set you up for success with training, certifications, and knowledge tests to ensure you meet the Dutch Bros standards.

Why You’ll Love It Here

  • We’ve got your back. Competitive pay & tips, opportunities for tuition reimbursement, and career growth within the shops, HQ, Emerging Talent Program, and warehouse/fulfillment opportunities.
  • Perks on perks. Free drinks & food on shift, exclusive Dutch Bros swag and giveaway items, and a work environment like no other.
  • Make a difference. Every cup you serve supports local & national communities and brings people together.
  • Room to grow. We believe in pouring into our people; Broista today, leader tomorrow! We’re set to double in size within the next three years which means a ton of growth opportunities for you.

At Dutch Bros, our culture is unmatched. We’re a fun, tight-knit crew that supports each other and creates connections you won’t find anywhere else. Ready to make a massive difference together?!

Compensation:

Up to $23.50 per hour

Number includes an average tip of $3.50 per hour. What we strive for: a fun environment, great co-workers, and a chance to make a difference in your community. What we don't guarantee: tip averages. Actual tips may vary based on a variety of factors including location, position, hours, and quality of service. Average hourly tips are based on 2025 reporting.

If you like wild growth and working in a unique and fun environment, surrounded by positive community, you'll enjoy your career with us!

title: Senior Project Manager
description:
The role:

We are looking for a Senior Project Manager to join our Transformation department in Bristol or London.

This is an exciting opportunity to join Simmons & Simmons at a pivotal moment in its transformation journey. As part of our newly established Transformation function, you will play a leading role in delivering some of the firm's most strategically important initiatives, helping to shape how we operate, serve our clients and embrace emerging technologies, including AI.

Reporting to the Head of Programme Management, the Senior Project Manager will lead complex, high-impact projects that span multiple business areas and stakeholder groups. Working closely with senior sponsors and leadership teams, you will drive initiatives from concept through to implementation, ensuring successful outcomes whilst helping to establish a modern, enterprise-wide approach to project delivery.

This is more than a traditional project management role. It is an opportunity to influence the future direction of the firm, work on a diverse portfolio of transformational and operational change, and contribute to building a best-in-class project delivery capability at the heart of the organisation.

What will you do:

  • Lead the delivery of complex, strategically significant transformation and operational change initiatives.

  • Partner with sponsors and senior stakeholders to shape delivery approaches, implementation strategies and business outcomes.

  • Establish and maintain project plans, budgets, governance structures and reporting mechanisms.

  • Manage complex risks, issues, dependencies and organisational impacts across multiple workstreams

  • Lead project boards, steering committees and executive governance forums.

  • Ensure projects deliver measurable business value and remain aligned to strategic objectives.

  • Coordinate multidisciplinary teams across business, technology and external suppliers.

  • Drive stakeholder engagement, change adoption and business readiness activities.

  • Mentor and support Project Managers, sharing expertise and promoting delivery excellence.

  • Contribute to the ongoing development of project management standards, governance and ways of working across the Transformation function.

  • Support portfolio planning and prioritisation activities alongside the PMO and senior leadership.

What we are looking for:

We're looking for an experienced and ambitious project leader who thrives in complex environments and enjoys turning strategy into tangible business outcomes. You'll be motivated by the opportunity to deliver meaningful change, influence senior decision-makers and play a key role in shaping the future of the firm.

You will bring:

  • A strong track record of successfully delivering complex business, technology or transformation projects and programmes.

  • Experience working with senior executives, sponsors and cross-functional leadership teams.

  • Excellent stakeholder engagement, communication and influencing skills.

  • Strong commercial awareness, including experience managing budgets, forecasts and business cases.

  • Proven ability to lead multidisciplinary teams and navigate ambiguity, complexity and competing priorities.

  • Experience driving organisational change and supporting business adoption.

  • A proactive, collaborative and delivery-focused mindset.

  • A passion for continuous improvement and helping to build high-performing delivery teams.

  • A professional project management qualification (APM, PRINCE2, PMP or equivalent) is desirable.

Career Level:

The career level assigned to this role is level 4. The career level framework provides a formal structure for the business services functions at the firm. The framework, which ranges from level 1 to level 7, clearly defines the responsibilities, skills and competencies required at each level.

Here at Simmons & Simmons:

At Simmons, we are proud of our collaborative, open and non-hierarchical culture, where everyone is treated with respect and dignity and the wellbeing of our people is paramount. Our dynamic minds work as one integrated team, partnering with leading organisations on inspirational and thought-provoking projects that matter. From day one, irrespective of job title, qualification or background, everyone’s voice is heard, and you are encouraged to have an enquiring mind and share ideas that drive the firm forward. Through innovative learning and development opportunities, you will have a platform to excel, exceed your career ambitions, and achieve things you never thought possible.

Some key information:

  • We offer a competitive package including bonuses dependant on role/level, private medical insurance and pension contribution.

  • Our global skills academy provides our people, regardless of their role and location, with excellent learning opportunities (including live workshops, podcasts, short videos and practical learning experiences).

  • We have adopted a hybrid working approach with a requirement for a minimum of three days in the office with flexibility dependant on role/team/client demands.

  • We are proud to rank as a Times Top 50 Employer for Gender Equality, a Stonewall Top Global Employer, and a Top 75 Employer for Social Mobility.

  • We have a range of social and sports committees, summer and winter parties and monthly get togethers.

  • We have a range of diversity networks to connect people and celebrate our differences which is integral to our inclusive culture.

  • All UK offices have their own artwork collections – including Damien Hirst and Tracey Emin pieces in the London office. We have a long-standing history in supporting the art community especially up-and-coming artists.

  • We have recently introduced a Strategic Advisory Council which is a mix of associates and business services who will propose strategic initiatives that align with our firm's mission and support the delivery of our business plan, shaping the future of our next-generation law firm.

  • Our in-house generative AI tool, Percy, won the ‘Innovation in Automation and AI Tools’ category at the 2024 FT Innovative Lawyers Europe Awards. This achievement highlights our commitment to technological innovation and client service.

  • We have been commended in The Times Best Law Firms 2026 across three categories: construction, employment, and intellectual property. Our profile is highly positive, highlighting our sector specialisms and notable case and transactional work.

Equal opportunities:

We are committed to fostering equality, diversity and inclusion within our firm and to ensuring equal employment opportunities. We believe that this commitment creates a vibrant and rewarding work environment. We are therefore committed to:

  • Upholding equal opportunities, regardless of race, ethnicity, religion, belief, age, disability, sexual orientation, sex, gender reassignment, gender identity, marital status, or pregnancy, including maternity and paternity. This commitment extends to addressing any instances of perceived or associative discrimination and harassment. We also ensure fair treatment during recruitment and selection processes for those who are serving or have served in the armed forces, along with their families.

  • Accommodating requests for flexible working arrangements whenever possible. We encourage you to discuss your needs with us if this is something you require.

  • Making our roles accessible to individuals with diverse abilities. If you need any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know so we can meet your needs.

  • We offer a range of employee networks to support our colleagues. More information about these networks can be found in the D&I Information booklet that candidates are sent when invited to interview.

We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every single requirement. We are looking for individuals who are passionate and eager to learn and grow with us. Your unique experiences and perspectives could be a great addition to our team.

We reserve the right to close this vacancy early if we receive sufficient applications for the role. Therefore, if you are interested, please submit your application as early as possible.

If you’re interested in finding out more about this position, please contact the Recruitment Team. To apply for the role, click on the link at the top of the page or visit our careers page for more details.

title: SECURITY OPERATIONS ORCHESTRATION MANAGER
description:
Join Corrs Chambers Westgarth, Australia's leading independent law firm.

Corrs Chambers Westgarth is seeking an experienced Information Security Operations Orchestration Manager to play a key role in leading and evolving the firm’s security operations capability.

Based in Melbourne, this role sits within Information Services and supports the Head of Security & Risk in overseeing the day-to-day security operations across the firm. It is a highly visible role for someone who can bring together people, platforms, automation, external providers and AI-enabled capability to deliver a modern, intelligence-led security operations function.

This is an opportunity to take ownership of a broad and business-critical portfolio, spanning incident response, security monitoring, vulnerability lifecycle management, ISO/IEC 27001 assurance, vendor performance, commercial input and continuous improvement.

At Corrs, we help you achieve your ambition - at every stage of your career.

In this role, you will:

  • Lead the daily rhythm of security operations, including monitoring, investigations, vulnerability management and incident response.
  • Own the end-to-end security operations lifecycle, from detection and investigation through to response, recovery and continuous improvement.
  • Orchestrate security analysts, automation platforms, AI-enabled tools and external providers into one cohesive operating model.
  • Prioritise security activity based on business risk, impact and materiality, not just alert volume.
  • Design and maintain playbooks, workflows and escalation pathways that support clear, consistent and auditable outcomes.
  • Lead the safe and governed use of AI for alert enrichment, correlation, prioritisation and response recommendations, with appropriate human oversight.
  • Act as the operational lead for cyber security incidents, coordinating technical teams, Legal, Risk, Communications and external responders as required.
  • Maintain and improve incident response and disaster recovery plans, including regular testing to assess readiness.
  • Own and evolve key security operations platforms, ensuring tools, services and vendor arrangements meet current and future business needs.
  • Partner with Procurement and Technology on vendor evaluations, proof-of-value activities, service scope, SLAs, KPIs, renewals and uplift discussions.
  • Take direct responsibility for the ongoing management and continual improvement of Corrs’ ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Information Security Management System.
  • Translate operational data into clear executive-level insights, including security performance, vendor effectiveness, automation value and cost efficiency.

About You

You will be a confident and commercially minded security operations professional who can balance technical depth with strong stakeholder engagement, governance discipline and practical judgement.

You will bring:

  • Experience leading security operations, incident response or cyber security functions in a medium to large corporate environment.
  • Strong knowledge of security standards and obligations, including ISO/IEC 27001, ACSC Essential Eight and relevant aspects of the Australian Privacy Act.
  • Proven experience managing and sustaining an ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Information Security Management System, including audit preparation, evidence management and coordination with external auditors.
  • A strong understanding of security operations tooling, operating models and service provider environments.
  • Experience working with vendors and managed or co-managed service providers in operational environments.
  • The ability to communicate clearly with technical teams, business stakeholders and executive audiences.
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills, particularly in high-risk or time-sensitive situations.
  • The ability to balance technical, legal, regulatory, reputational and commercial considerations.

Experience selecting, implementing or operating SOAR or AI-enabled security platforms will be highly regarded. Experience contributing to commercial negotiations, SLA reviews, KPI discussions, renewals or service uplift activities will also be highly valued.

Why this role?

This is a strategic, hands-on opportunity for someone who wants to shape the next generation of security operations in a professional services environment. You will have the scope to uplift capability, improve operating models, influence vendor and platform strategy, and support a security function that is increasingly intelligence-led, automation-enabled and commercially mature.

You will work closely with senior stakeholders across Technology, Legal, Risk, Communications, Procurement and external providers, playing a key role in protecting the firm while enabling practical, well-governed and business-aligned security outcomes

About us:
Corrs Chambers Westgarth is Australia’s leading independent law firm. We provide exceptional legal services across the full spectrum of matters, including major transactions, projects and significant disputes, offering strategic advice on our clients’ most challenging issues.

Why Corrs?
We pride ourselves on meeting our clients needs in a culture characterised by excellence, commitment, collaboration and respect. Our policies, practices and behaviours foster a safe and inclusive workplace, and we focus on creating opportunities and supporting a diverse workforce.

  • Flexible working as standard – we’ve established flexibility as standard business practice and an option for all our people.
  • Bonus leave - an additional week of leave each year (5 weeks annual leave in total)
  • Generous parental leave entitlements - we offer up to 26 weeks paid leave and pay superannuation on both paid and unpaid leave (up to 12 months)
  • Wellbeing program –We support the wellbeing of our people across areas including resilience, mental health, mindfulness, personal development, physical health and self-care.
  • Diversity and Inclusion – This is a key area of focus for the firm. We set meaningful goals to improve diversity and foster an inclusive culture in which all employees feel supported and valued.
  • Responsible business approach – we are a member of the United Nations Global Compact, and are committed to promoting and respecting human rights, supporting the Compact’s Ten Principles on human rights, labour, environment and anti-corruption, and the UN’s Sustainable Development Goals. title: BI Analyst
description:
Job Description

Serves as a strategic analytics partner to the Special Investigations Unit (SIU) and Payment Integrity teams by delivering actionable business intelligence, financial reporting, operational insights, and statistically sound audit support. This role combines advanced data analysis, dashboard development, healthcare claims expertise, and stakeholder engagement to identify fraud, waste, abuse, payment accuracy opportunities, and operational improvement initiatives.

The analyst develops reporting and analytical solutions that support provider investigations, overpayment recovery efforts, prepayment and post-payment audit programs, and executive decision-making. This role is responsible for translating complex healthcare data into meaningful insights, measuring program effectiveness, supporting statistically valid sampling methodologies, and driving measurable savings and operational efficiencies across the organization.
  • Partner with Special Investigations Unit (SIU), Payment Integrity, Clinical, Finance, and operational stakeholders to identify business needs and develop analytical solutions that support fraud, waste, abuse detection, payment accuracy, and operational performance management.
  • Design, develop, and maintain dashboards, scorecards, reports, and self-service analytics solutions that provide actionable insights into investigation outcomes, provider risk, savings, recoveries, cost avoidance, inventory management, and key performance indicators.
  • Analyze healthcare claims, provider, member, audit, and investigation data to identify trends, anomalies, emerging risks, and opportunities for financial and operational improvement.
  • Develop recurring and ad hoc financial and operational reporting used by leadership to measure program effectiveness, resource utilization, productivity, return on investment, and strategic objectives.
  • Design, execute, validate, and document statistically valid random sampling methodologies to support provider audits, overpayment identification, error rate measurement, and extrapolation activities.
  • Collaborate with business partners, BI Analysts, Data Scientists, and others to define data requirements, improve data quality, and operationalize advanced analytical solutions.
  • Facilitate requirements gathering, solution design, and stakeholder review sessions to ensure reporting and analytical solutions meet business objectives and deliver measurable value.
  • Validate data accuracy, reconcile reporting outputs, and ensure consistency of financial, operational, and analytical metrics across multiple systems and audiences.
  • Communicate analytical findings, insights, risks, and recommendations to business partners and leadership through effective visualizations, presentations, and written summaries.
  • Establish and maintain reporting standards, documentation, governance practices, and development methodologies to ensure scalable, reliable, and sustainable analytical solutions.
  • Manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously while proactively communicating status, risks, dependencies, and opportunities to stakeholders and leadership.

What You Bring

Required

  • Bachelor's degree or advanced degree (where required)
  • 3+ years of experience in healthcare analytics, SIU, Payment Integrity, or a related field
  • In lieu of degree, 5+ years of experience in related field.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

Preferred

  • Experience supporting Special Investigations Unit (SIU), Fraud, Waste & Abuse (FWA), Payment Integrity, claims auditing, or provider payment review functions.
  • Knowledge of healthcare claims processing, reimbursement methodologies, CPT, HCPCS, ICD-10, DRG, and provider billing practices.
  • Experience with statistical sampling methodologies, confidence intervals, extrapolation, and audit-related analytics.
  • Experience measuring healthcare savings, recoveries, cost avoidance, and operational performance metrics.
  • Experience with Snowflake
  • Experience building AI agents

Salary Range

Compensation decisions are driven by factors including experience and training, specialized skill sets, licensure and certifications and other business and organizational needs. Our base salary is part of a robust Total Rewards package that includes an Annual Incentive Bonus*, 401(k) with employer match, Paid Time Off (PTO), and competitive health benefits and wellness programs.

*Based on annual corporate goal achievement and individual performance.

title: Erfaren veterinærsygeplejerske søges som henvisningskoordinator til AniCura Københavns Dyrehospital
description:
AniCura Københavns Dyrehospital er en moderne, døgnbemandet skadestue og henvisningshospital med høj faglighed og stærke specialiserede teams. Vi modtager både akutte og henviste patienter fra dyreklinikker i store dele af landet og tilbyder avanceret diagnostik, intensiv pleje og behandling af patienter med både akutte og komplekse sygdomsforløb.

Dyrehospitalet råder blandt andet over egen blodbank, intensivafdeling, isolationsafdeling og CT-scanner, hvilket giver os mulighed for at håndtere alt fra kritiske patienter til specialiserede udredninger og længere behandlingsforløb. Vores faglige specialer omfatter blandt andet intern medicin, kardiologi, oftalmologi, ortopædi, kirurgi og billeddiagnostik, hvor vores teams arbejder tæt sammen for at sikre den bedst mulige behandling og et sammenhængende patientforløb.

AniCura en del af MARS Veterinary Health, en organisation bestående af mangle dyreklinikker i et internationalt fagligt fællesskab på tværs af lande med adgang til videndeling, faglig sparring og løbende udvikling inden for veterinærmedicin – til gavn for både patienter, klienter og medarbejdere.

Stillingen:

Vi søger en erfaren veterinærsygeplejerske med et stort engagement, stærke samarbejdsevner og interesse for at være en del af et fagligt miljø, hvor kvalitet, relationer og udvikling er i fokus.

I rollen som henvisningskoordinator bliver du den første kontakt til den henvisende dyrlæge, både telefonisk og via e-mail, og er med til at styrke relationen til vores henvisende dyreklinikker gennem høj faglighed, professionalisme, tydelig kommunikation og tæt samarbejde. Du får en vigtig rolle i at sikre, at behovene hos de henvisende dyrlæger imødekommes, og du bidrager til at skabe værdi gennem høj service, faglig sparring og et sammenhængende henvisningsforløb. Du har en naturlig interesse og kompetence inden for kundeservice, kommunikation og samarbejde, og du møder altid vores henvisende dyrlæger professionelt og imødekommende.

Du bliver en del af et stærkt og engageret team, som arbejder tæt sammen om at skabe de bedste oplevelser for både klienter og henvisende dyrlæger. Sammen arbejder vi målrettet med klientfokus, kundetilfredshed og et professionelt henvisningssamarbejde, hvor relationer, kvalitet og service er i centrum og bidrager til den bedste patientoplevelse.

I vores team arbejder vi aktivt med løbende udvikling og optimering af arbejdsgange, vidensdeling, tværfagligt samarbejde og fælles faglig udvikling. Vi vægter et positivt arbejdsmiljø højt og tror på, at de bedste patient- og kundeoplevelser skabes gennem stærkt teamwork, engagement og gensidig støtte i hverdagen.

Arbejdsbeskrivelse:

Din rolle er at sikre et professionelt og velfungerende henvisningsforløb, og du vil blandt andet arbejde med:

• Tydelig kommunikation med henvisende dyreklinikker

• Opbygning af stærke relationer og et tæt samarbejde med vores henvisende dyreklinikker

• Overblik, koordinering og tværfagligt samarbejde omkring patientforløb på tværs af dyrehospitalets specialafdelinger

• Sikring af ensartet og høj kvalitet i kommunikation og henvisningsforløb

• Løbende udvikling og optimering af arbejdsgange og processer omkring den henviste patient

• Bidrage til et stabilt og velfungerende henvisningsflow

• Medvirke til vores henvisningsaftener, hvor henvisende dyrlæger og veterinærsygeplejersker bydes indenfor til arrangementer

• Medvirkende til at sikre overholdelse af AniCuras standarder for kvalitet og sikkerhed i overensstemmelse med gældende retningslinjer

Dine kvalifikationer:

• Du er en erfaren autoriseret veterinærsygeplejerske med gode kommunikationsevner – både skriftligt og mundtligt.

• Du trives i et teamorienteret miljø, hvor gode relationer til henvisende dyreklinikker, klienter og kollegaer er i fokus

• Du arbejder effektivt og formår samtidig at håndtere henvisninger med tålmodighed, lydhørhed, omsorg og faglighed

• Du har gode organisatoriske evner, et godt overblik og arbejder struktureret med fokus på høj og ensartet kvalitet

• Du er fleksibel og motiveres af at bidrage til en dynamisk og udviklingsorienteret arbejdsplads

• Du er velformuleret på dansk og føler dig tryg ved at kommunikere på engelsk

• Du trives i en koordinerende rolle med mange kontaktflader og en varieret hverdag

Din arbejdsplads:

AniCura Københavns Dyrehospitals ambition er at være den mest attraktive arbejdsplads inden for veterinærbranchen. Vi dedikerer tid og ressourcer til udvikling af vores medarbejdere. Dette vil du opleve i en kultur med fokus på stærke sociale relationer, psykologisk tryghed, læring og personlig udvikling. Vi arbejder målrettet med anerkendelse og åben dialog og lægger vægt på et arbejdsmiljø, hvor der er plads til faglig sparring, udvikling og mulighed for at bidrage aktivt til fællesskabet. Vi arbejder med MARS Fem Principper: Kvalitet, Ansvar, Gensidighed, Effektivitet og Frihed som værdier og grundlag for vores kultur, samarbejde og måde at møde både patienter, klienter og kollegaer på i hverdagen.

Stillingen er normeret til ca. 30 timer ugentligt, og din arbejdstid planlægges i dagtimerne inden for tidsrummet kl. 8.00–16.00.

Inkluderet i den faste arbejdstid - arbejde hver 4. weekend og deltagelse i helligdagsrul i vores reception/modtagelse, hvor du er ansvarlig for at møde vores klienter og patienter med empati og omsorg både i telefonen, ved modtagelse og hjemsendelse. Derudover sikre du en professionel og behagelig servicering af vores klienter og patienter, så de føler sig trygge og set i venteværelset og du har et tæt samarbejde med dyrlæger og veterinærsygeplejersker på tværs af dyrehospitalet for at sikre en god klientoplevelse og patientbehandling.

Din arbejdsplads vil være AniCura Københavns Dyrehospital, Poppelstykket 11, 2450 København SV.

Ansøgningsfrist: 15. september 2026, vi indkalder til samtaler løbende.

Er du interesseret i at høre nærmere om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Teamleder Anja Stoffers på tlf. 20860906 eller på mail anja.stoffers@anicura.dk

title: PRODUCT MANAGER
description:
Job Description

CelebriOS is a software company building B2B SaaS products that help businesses make better decisions, streamline operations, and get more value from their data. Our products combine practical business workflows with intuitive technology designed for everyday use.

You will join the team building our new mid-market analytics platform and take ownership of a key product area from discovery through launch and iteration. Working closely with engineering, design, data, and commercial teams, you will help define what we build, why it matters, and how we measure whether it is delivering value for customers.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Own the roadmap and product direction for a defined area of the analytics platform

  • Lead customer discovery and translate customer needs, feedback, and market signals into clear product requirements

  • Work closely with engineering and design throughout the product development cycle rather than treating handoff as the end of the process

  • Define measurable outcomes and success criteria before launching new features, then evaluate results after release

  • Prioritize opportunities based on customer value, business impact, evidence, and engineering effort

  • Make clear trade-offs and communicate what the team is not building and why

  • Partner with sales and customer success to provide product context and support customer conversations

  • Use product analytics and qualitative feedback to continuously improve the product roadmap

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

  • 3+ years of product management experience in B2B software or SaaS

  • A track record of owning and shipping meaningful product outcomes from discovery through launch

  • Strong product judgment and a clear approach to prioritization and trade-offs

  • Comfortable challenging assumptions and saying no when the evidence does not support an idea

  • Ability to define meaningful product metrics and use data to evaluate hypotheses

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • Customer-focused mindset with an understanding of how product decisions translate into business value

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience with analytics, data, reporting, or business intelligence products

  • Technical or engineering background

  • Experience with product-led growth

  • Previous B2B SaaS experience serving mid-market customers

  • Familiarity with data-intensive workflows or complex business software

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

$120,000-$150,000 determined based on experience, product expertise, and overall fit for the role.

CelebriOS offers a remote-first working environment, professional development opportunities, and a benefits package designed to support our team. Full details of compensation, benefits, and other employment terms will be discussed during the interview process.

HIRING PROCESS

Application review → introductory conversation → product discussion → conversation with the team → offer.

We aim to keep the process focused and respectful of your time, with clear communication throughout the process.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

CelebriOS is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

If you need an accommodation at any stage of the hiring process, please let us know and we will work with you to make the process accessible.

title: Senior Finance Data Scientist
description:
We’re Capital on Tap
Capital on Tap started because small businesses were underserved. Big banks were slow, their products weren't fit for purpose, and small business owners often couldn't access what they needed. We set out to fix that.

Today we're a financial platform - not just a credit card company. We offer a best-in-class business credit card, SME-focused spend management platform, a savings product that hit £1 billion in funds within its first year, and a growing suite of tools and financial products that make running a small business easier.

1,000+ employees, £20bn in annual card spend, 200,000+ customers, 17,000+ Trustpilot reviews averaging 4.7 stars, and we're profitable. We’ve done a pretty good job so far, but we’re just getting started!

This is a Hybrid role, working from our London (Moorgate) offices 3 days per week.

Finance at Capital on Tap

Our Finance team sits at the heart of everything we do, working across our UK and US entities and collaborating closely with the rest of the business to keep our financial foundations solid as we grow. We're a lean, high-ownership team - you'll get real breadth across the finance function and plenty of room to shape how things are done as we scale.

What You'll Be Doing

We're hiring a Senior Data Scientist to join Capital on Tap, reporting to the Head of FP&A.

You'll own two linked workstreams - IFRS9 Expected Credit Loss (ECL), and portfolio modelling that feeds the financial model to produce forecasts. The work spans the UK and US revolving credit books, sitting close to Finance, Risk and Data Science.

Tech stack: Snowflake, dbt, Fivetran, Python, JupyterLab, Omni, and Kubernetes on Azure.

ECL

  • Build, calibrate, implement and monitor IFRS9 models (PD, LGD, EAD), including staging/SICR logic and macroeconomic overlays.
  • Run and harden month-end ECL production - scenario runs, combined outputs, and result checks into Snowflake.

Portfolio Modelling

  • Develop and maintain the portfolio model that feeds the financial model - active customers, balances, funding, repayments, finance charges and bad debt.
  • Diagnose drift, recalibrate assumptions and overlays, and deliver forecast inputs Finance can trust.

Across Both

  • Partner with FP&A, Risk and other stakeholders so model outputs land cleanly in the financial forecast, without unnecessary process or IT complexity.
  • Use AI tools confidently across the workflow, and help the team adopt practical AI-assisted ways of working.

We're Looking For

  • 2-5+ years building statistical/credit risk models in Python, and extracting and shaping data in SQL.
  • Credit risk modelling experience, ideally IFRS9 ECL (PD/LGD/EAD), staging and model monitoring - or a clear desire to build that expertise quickly.
  • Commercial understanding of revolving credit economics (utilisation, arrears, default, recoveries, portfolio growth).
  • Comfort working end-to-end - from analysis and calibration through to production runs and stakeholder-ready forecast inputs.
  • Curiosity and judgement in applying AI to modelling and engineering work, while keeping outputs explainable and controlled.
  • Ability to work autonomously with strong judgement and proactivity in a small team.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with some of our stack is helpful - Snowflake, dbt, Fivetran, Python, JupyterLab, Omni, Kubernetes on Azure.
  • Experience feeding portfolio/behavioural models into an FP&A or financial planning model.
  • Familiarity with LightGBM or similar gradient-boosted models for behavioural forecasts.
  • Exposure to model change control, independent validation, or year-end ECL disclosure packs.
  • Prior work across both UK and US (or multi-region) credit portfolios.

Diversity & Inclusion
We welcome, consider and encourage applications from anyone who shares our commitment to inclusivity. Join us in creating a space where authenticity thrives, and everyone can do their best work.

Great Work Deserves Great Perks
We try not to take ourselves too seriously (all the time) so we make sure our office is decked out with a pool table, arcade machine, beer tap, and a couple of office dogs thrown in for good measure. Check out our benefits:
Private Healthcare including dental and opticians services through Vitality

Annual Learning and Wellbeing Budget
Enhanced Parental Leave
Cycle to Work Scheme
Season Ticket Loan
6 free therapy sessions per year
Dog Friendly Offices
Free drinks and snacks in our offices

Check out more of our benefits, values and mission here.

Other Info

Email careers@capitalontap.com if you have any questions.

title: Data Quality / Governance Analyst
description:
Overview

DecisionPoint seeks a Data Quality / Governance Analyst to support Task 3 data governance, accuracy, and cross-system alignment for a large federal and DoD-aligned mission environment. This role validates data sources, maintains metadata rules and data dictionaries, supports tagging standards, and performs continuous quality checks to ensure accurate reporting, dashboards, and analytics.

The Data Quality / Governance Analyst collaborates closely with Task 2 and Task 3 reporting teams, dashboard developers, data owners, and PMO leadership to maintain consistent, reliable, and governable enterprise data.

This position is fully remote.

Duties & Responsibilities

The Data Quality / Governance Analyst will:

  • Validate Task 3 data sources and assess accuracy, completeness, and reliability.
  • Maintain data dictionaries, metadata rules, tagging standards, and classification definitions.
  • Ensure consistency of KPIs, metrics, and datasets across Tasks 2 and 3.
  • Perform data reconciliation, profiling, cleansing, and quality checks.
  • Support cross-task data harmonization and integration workflows.
  • Identify data anomalies, gaps, or inconsistencies and recommend remediation steps.
  • Collaborate with dashboard teams, analysts, and system owners to align data definitions.
  • Maintain documentation for data governance processes, metadata rules, and data lineage.
  • Track source system changes, schema updates, and data dependency impacts.
  • Support adherence to federal data governance standards and reporting requirements.
  • Provide input into dashboard specifications, metric definitions, and reporting standardization.

Qualifications

Clearance Requirement

Candidate must possess an active Secret clearance or higher.

Education (Required)

Bachelor’s degree in Information Management, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or a related discipline.

Experience (Required)

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in data governance, data quality, metadata management, or analytics.
  • Experience maintaining data dictionaries, metadata rules, and standardized data fields.
  • Experience performing data validation, reconciliation, profiling, or cleansing.
  • Experience supporting cross-team or cross-system data harmonization efforts.

Technical Knowledge (Required)

  • Understanding of data governance frameworks, data quality principles, and metadata standards.
  • Proficiency with Excel, SQL, or similar tools for data validation and analysis.
  • Familiarity with KPI frameworks and structured metric definitions.

Technical Knowledge (Preferred)

  • Experience with Power BI, Tableau, Grafana, or similar BI tools.
  • Familiarity with cloud data platforms or ETL/ELT tools.

Certifications

Preferred:

  • ITIL v4 Foundation
  • Data governance or data management certifications

Skills

  • High attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent communication and documentation skills.
  • Ability to work across multiple technical and business teams.
  • Strong organizational skills for tracking complex datasets and governance workflows.

Our Equal Employment Opportunity Policy

  • EEO and Affirmative Action Policy: DecisionPoint Corporation is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. It is the policy of DecisionPoint Corporation to provide equal employment opportunity in accordance with all applicable Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action laws, directives and regulations to all employees and qualified applicants without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other protected status under Federal, State or Local laws.
  • Pay Transparency Policy: In accordance with Presidential Executive Order 13665, DecisionPoint Corporation will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay or the pay of another employee or applicant. However, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as a part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) consistent with the contractor's legal duty to furnish information.
  • Authorization to Share Resume and Personal Information: By expressing your interest and submitting your resume for this position, you authorize DecisionPoint Corporation to share your resume, as well as personal information included on the resume, with its subsidiaries, affiliates and teaming partners for the purpose of considering you for this position and other available positions requiring comparable skills, education and experience. Should DecisionPoint Corporation. or its affiliates and teaming partners wish to initiate pre-employment discussions, you will be asked to complete an employment application and related employment documents.

The Change Management Specialist applies knowledge of VA databases, project management tools and techniques, and change management theory and applications supporting the VHA Office of Clinical Informatics (OCI) in the stabilization, recovery, and Post Go-Live (PGL) operation of the Oracle Health Federal Electronic Health Record (EHR), with a functional focus on accelerating execution of VHA's organizational change management strategy for EHR adoption.

Description

Looking for an amazing new claims opportunity? Senior Complex Construction Claims Specialist — Complex CGL & Construction Liability (Litigated, $500K+)

Overview

Liberty Mutual’s Specialized Claims group has an immediate opening on our Complex Construction Claims Team. We’re seeking an experienced claims professional who thrives on challenging, high-exposure commercial casualty matters arising from construction operations — including complex Commercial General Liability (CGL) and Construction Injury/Liability claims (all litigated or high-exposure losses $500,000+). You will own matters end-to-end, managing coverage and liability strategy, directing investigations and experts, coordinating litigation and outside counsel, and driving timely, defensible resolutions for our Construction Industry accounts. (Note: this role does not handle construction defect claims.)

Why this role is a great fit for you

  • Work exclusively on technically complex, high-exposure construction-related casualty claims that require advanced legal and claims judgment.
  • Autonomy to set strategy, reserves and resolution plans, with authority to direct investigations and manage outside counsel and experts.
  • Opportunity to influence outcomes across underwriting, product and legal teams and to be a recognized technical resource on construction liability issues.
  • Exposure to multi-party, catastrophic injury and cross-coverage matters — valuable experience for senior claims leaders and litigators.
  • Flexibility with structure. This role is primarily remote, with a light-touch office cadence - just two in-office days per month for those who live within 50 miles of one of our hub locations in Boston, MA; Hoffman Estates, IL; Indianapolis, IN; Lake Oswego, OR; Las Vegas, NV; Plano, TX; Suwanee, GA; Chandler, AZ; and Weatogue, CT. Policy is subject to change.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage a caseload of complex, litigated construction-related losses ($500K+) from assignment through resolution: coverage analysis, liability assessment, investigation planning, reserving, negotiation, settlement or denial where appropriate.
  • Lead coverage interpretation and application for issues commonly encountered in construction claims: additional insureds, tenders, indemnity agreements, other insurance, SIR/deductible mechanics, primary vs. excess placement, and limits erosion.
  • Direct litigation strategy: analyze pleadings, manage discovery and depositions, evaluate venue and trial risk, prepare for mediations and settlement conferences, and recommend and implement resolution strategies.
  • Build and lead the working team for each matter: coordinate Home-Office Legal, defense counsel, SIU when appropriate, medical and causation experts, accident reconstructionist, engineers, and other technical consultants.
  • Select, supervise and evaluate outside counsel, including establishing budgets, staffing plans, billing guidelines expectations, and performance measures.
  • Set and adjust reserves based on defensible analysis and develop settlement strategies that protect the company’s interests while advancing timely resolution.
  • Maintain accurate, complete file documentation and ensure secure handling of financial transactions and claim information.
  • Collaborate proactively with Underwriting, Risk Control, Reinsurance/Excess, Product and Subrogation teams; identify and communicate trends and technical insights.
  • Mentor and coach less-experienced claims professionals and contribute to team training, process improvements, and special projects.

What we seek in a candidate

An experienced claims professional with a strong Commercial General Liability and/or Construction Liability background (preferably with claims $500,000 and above), sound judgment on complex coverage and liability questions, and the confidence to lead files, mentor others, and manage litigation strategy independently.

Qualifications

What we’re looking for — Required

  • Substantial hands-on experience handling complex, litigated Commercial General Liability and/or Construction Liability claims at high exposure levels (preferably $500,000+).
  • Deep working knowledge of CGL and Construction Liability coverages and typical construction-related policy issues (additional insured wording, contractual indemnity, other insurance, primary/excess interaction, SIRs/deductibles).
  • Proven litigation management experience: selecting/managing defense counsel, directing discovery strategy, preparing for mediation/trial, evaluating exposure and settlement leverage.
  • Strong technical judgment and the ability to articulate and defend coverage and liability positions to legal, underwriting, and management partners.
  • Track record of using and directing experts (medical, causation, engineers, reconstruction) on complex causation and damages issues.
  • Excellent negotiation, communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple high-priority matters and meet deadlines under pressure.
  • Bachelor’s degree (preferred) and relevant claims/insurance industry certifications or licenses as applicable.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain needed All-lines Adjuster license. Claims/Industry certifications a plus!
About Us

Pay Philosophy: The typical starting salary range for this role is determined by a number of factors including skills, experience, education, certifications and location. The full salary range for this role reflects the competitive labor market value for all employees in these positions across the national market and provides an opportunity to progress as employees grow and develop within the role. Some roles at Liberty Mutual have a corresponding compensation plan which may include commission and/or bonus earnings at rates that vary based on multiple factors set forth in the compensation plan for the role.

At Liberty Mutual, our goal is to create a workplace where everyone feels valued, supported, and can thrive. We build an environment that welcomes a wide range of perspectives and experiences, with inclusion embedded in every aspect of our culture and reflected in everyday interactions. This comes to life through comprehensive benefits, workplace flexibility, professional development opportunities, and a host of opportunities provided through our Employee Resource Groups. Each employee plays a role in creating our inclusive culture, which supports every individual to do their best work. Together, we cultivate a community where everyone can make a meaningful impact for our business, our customers, and the communities we serve.

We value your hard work, integrity and commitment to make things better, and we put people first by offering you benefits that support your life and well-being. To learn more about our benefit offerings please visit:
