title: CDM Analyst - Revenue Integrity - Remote
description:
Your job is more than a job

REMOTE REQUIREMENT

Must be a resident of Texas, Louisiana, Mississippi, Alabama, Florida or Georgia

The CDM (Charge Description Master) Analyst is responsible for supporting the maintenance and optimization of the Charge Description Master (CDM) by analyzing charge codes, conducting data audits, and ensuring regulatory compliance. The CDM Analyst plays a critical role in ensuring the accuracy and efficiency of charge capture processes across clinical departments.

Your Everyday

  • Review and analyze CDM data to ensure that all charge codes are accurate, current, and compliant with industry standards and payer regulations.
  • Conduct regular audits of charge codes, procedure codes, and pricing to identify discrepancies or areas for improvement.
  • Assist in updating the CDM by adding, modifying, or deleting charge codes as needed, in line with regulatory changes or departmental requests.
  • Ensure that all changes to the CDM are appropriately documented and communicated to relevant departments.
  • Analyze charge capture processes to ensure that services provided are accurately billed and correctly reflected in the CDM.
  • Identify any missing or incorrect charges, working with clinical and billing teams to resolve issues.
  • Ensure that all updates and modifications to the CDM adhere to regulatory guidelines, such as those from CMS, Medicare, Medicaid, and other payers.
  • Monitor industry changes and payer updates to stay informed of new coding and billing requirements.
  • Work with clinical, billing, and coding departments to address charge capture issues and ensure proper usage of CDM codes.
  • Act as a resource for staff on CDM-related inquiries and charge coding concerns.
  • Participate in audits of the CDM, assisting with the identification of any discrepancies in charge capture and compliance.
  • Provide documentation and analysis during external audits, ensuring timely and accurate responses.
  • Generate reports on CDM activity, including charge capture trends, audit results, and compliance metrics.
  • Ensure the integrity and accuracy of CDM-related data by performing regular data quality checks.
  • Identify opportunities to improve charge capture processes and optimize revenue by analyzing CDM usage and patterns.
  • Provide recommendations for enhancing the efficiency and accuracy of CDM-related operations.

The Must-Haves

Minimum:

  • Review and analyze CDM data to ensure that all charge codes are accurate, current, and compliant with industry standards and payer regulations.
  • Conduct regular audits of charge codes, procedure codes, and pricing to identify discrepancies or areas for improvement.

  • Act as a resource for staff on CDM-related inquiries and charge coding concerns.
  • Participate in audits of the CDM, assisting with the identification of any discrepancies in charge capture and compliance.
  • Provide documentation and analysis during external audits, ensuring timely and accurate responses.
  • Generate reports on CDM activity, including charge capture trends, audit results, and compliance metrics.
  • Ensure the integrity and accuracy of CDM-related data by performing regular data quality checks.
  • Identify opportunities to improve charge capture processes and optimize revenue by analyzing CDM usage and patterns.
  • Provide recommendations for enhancing the efficiency and accuracy of CDM-related operations.

EXPERIENCE QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 3+ years of experience in healthcare auditing, revenue integrity, revenue cycle management, healthcare finance, or a related field
  • Minimum of 2 years’ experience as an analyst in a healthcare environment with emphasis on chargemaster, revenue capture, charge auditing, reporting and reimbursement.
  • Must have 3 years of experience in a hospital or professional based CPT-4, HCPCS Level II coding and outpatient ICD-10-CM coding experience for multiple hospital departments.
  • Strong knowledge of Chargemaster (CDM) management, including charge capture processes, coding (CPT, HCPCS, ICD-10), and compliance with CMS and third-party payer requirements.
  • 2+ years of Epic experience, particularly in managing work queues and charge capture functions

EDUCATION QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Minimum: An associate’s degree in healthcare administration, health information management, or a related field is required.
  • Preferred: Bachelor's degree in healthcare

LICENSES AND CERTIFICATIONS:

  • Preferred: AAPC or AHIMA credential or Epic Certified

SKILLS AND ABILITIES:

  • Demonstrate knowledge of OPPS reimbursement methodologies, as well as Medicare reimbursement and billing guidelines, familiar with CMS transmittals and manuals, and with the cms.gov website to obtain quarterly HCPCS, OCE, and MUE updates
  • Demonstrate knowledge of NUBC revenue codes, mapping structures, UB-04 claim and payment remittance advice statements
  • Demonstrate knowledge of the medical necessity of services through the CMS Local and National coverage Determinations
  • Demonstrated ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships at all levels.

title: DevOps Engineer II
description:
As a DevOps engineer at Level Data, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining infrastructure to support service delivery across multiple stacks. You will work closely with several teams, including Software Engineering and Security, to provide a stable and secure hosting stack for some of the best-loved software services in the K-12 Education market.

Your day-to-day duties will include working with several cloud environments, including AWS and Azure, as well as datacenter environments. You will be expected to utilize modern technologies (Kubernetes, Terraform, Prometheus, Grafana, etc.) and to be flexible in finding solutions across a variety of environments. This will involve both supporting customer-facing production environments, as well as internal tooling to be used by technical teams.

This is a mid-level position. You will own well-scoped work end to end with limited supervision, and contribute to larger initiatives under the direction of senior engineers. The role suits someone with solid hands-on fundamentals who is ready to grow into broader system ownership, and who is comfortable asking questions, learning in the open, and partnering with Software Engineering teams on day-to-day delivery.

Responsibilities

  • Infrastructure Implementation & Support: Build, deploy, and maintain infrastructure across production, QA, and development environments. Contribute to design discussions and implement changes that follow established platform standards and patterns.

  • CI/CD Pipeline Development: Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Flux CD, GitLab, and Azure DevOps. Troubleshoot pipeline failures, improve build reliability and speed, and apply existing pipeline and release standards.

  • Automation & Tooling: Write and maintain automation using Python, Bash, PowerShell, or similar languages. Identify repetitive manual work on the team and replace it with tooling.

  • Observability & Incident Response: Implement and tune monitoring, logging, and alerting for the services you support. Participate in on-call and incident response, perform first-line triage, and contribute findings to root-cause analysis and runbooks.

  • Cross-Team Collaboration: Work day to day with engineering, security, and operations teams to unblock delivery. Document what you build, review peers' merge requests, and help onboard newer engineers to team tooling and practices.

  • Security & Compliance Practices: Apply established security and compliance controls in infrastructure and pipelines (DevSecOps) — secrets management, patching, vulnerability remediation — and escalate risks you identify.

  • Cloud Operations & Cost Awareness: Operate and maintain resources across AWS, Azure, or GCP, including networking and identity configuration. Surface cost-saving opportunities and implement approved optimizations.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 2+ years of experience in DevOps, systems administration, cloud operations, or a related field.

  • Experience managing and troubleshooting Linux environments.

  • Proficiency with version control systems (e.g. git).

  • Hands-on experience running and troubleshooting containerized workloads in Kubernetes (or Docker, Nomad, etc.).

  • Working experience with cloud services like AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.

  • Practical experience using IaC tools like Terraform.

  • Scripting ability in at least one language (Python, Bash, PowerShell, or similar).

  • Certifications in relevant cloud technologies (e.g., AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, Azure DevOps Solutions Expert, CKAD, CKA) — held or in progress — are a plus.

NOTE: This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. Employees may perform other related duties to meet the ongoing needs of the organization. All positions are required to complete a pre-employment drug screen and background check.

title: Personlig assistent till tjej i centrala Sandviken
description:
Nu kan vi på OP Assistans erbjuda en möjlighet till en ordinarie tjänst som personlig assistent i Sandviken!

Kunden är en tjej boende i Sandviken. Här börjar alla nya assistenter som timvikarier för att ni först ska få lära känna varandra. För rätt person kan det sedan finnas möjlighet till en större schemarad.

Arbetspassen är förlagda på dygnspass med väntetid. Arbetet utförs där kunden befinner sig. Vilket kan vara både i och utanför kundens hem.

Kunden är en kvinna som bor i eget boende i Sandviken.

I dina arbetsuppgifter kommer det bland annat att ingå stöttning vid:

  • Förflyttningar och motoriskt stöd

  • Kommunikation

  • Personlig omvårdnad

  • Tillsyn och upprätthållande av struktur och rutiner

  • Sociala och vardagliga aktiviteter

För oss är kunden i fokus, och vi söker dig som är av samma inställning.
Du är öppen och flexibel för att jobba utifrån kundens behov och önskemål. Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet och det absolut viktigaste är att personkemin mellan dig och vår kund fungerar mycket bra.

Vi är varandras arbetsmiljö
Vi värnar om om varandra som kollegor och söker dig som delar våra värderingar även kring detta. Ett gott arbetsklimat gynnar både kund och assistent och vi strävar efter en familjär och välkomnande atmosfär där ett sammansvetsat team arbetar tillsammans mot samma mål: kundens bästa.

Förutom detta så finns det några krav för att du ska kunna jobba hos vår kund, nämligen:

  • Du är rökfri

  • Du hanterar svenska språket mycket väl i kommunikation och förståelse

  • Du kan arbeta dygnspass med väntetid

  • Du har tillräckligt god fysisk kapacitet för att klara en aktiv arbetsdag


Det är också meriterande om du:

  • Har erfarenhet av personlig assistans eller annat vårdrelaterat yrke

Rekryteringsprocessen
Urval sker löpande och tjänsten kan tillsättas före sista ansökningsdagen.

Vid eventuell anställning
En förutsättning för att påbörja en anställning hos oss är att du som söker kan uppvisa giltig ID-handling.
För att säkerställa att alla kandidater som går vidare kan styrka sin rätt att arbeta i Sverige, ber vi även om personbevis från samtliga.
Personbeviset beställer du kostnadsfritt via Skatteverkets webbplats och kan laddas ner direkt med BankID här.
Registerutdrag: För anställning hos oss krävs utdrag ur belastningsregistret. Det är viktigt att utdragen beställs i god tid, eftersom Polisens handläggningstid kan variera.
Med anledning av lagändring från den 1 mars 2026 utökas registerkontrollen till att omfatta både utdrag ur belastningsregistret och utdrag från misstankeregistret.

Vi rekommenderar att du säkerställer att du har aktuella utdrag enligt de nya reglerna.

På grund av att tjänsten kan omfatta ensamarbete, nattarbete och arbetsuppgifter som enligt Arbetsmiljöverkets föreskrifter (AFS 2012:3) inte får utföras av minderåriga, måste du ha fyllt 18 år för att jobba som personlig assistent hos oss.

OP Assistans erbjuder trygg och respektfull personlig assistans.
Vi bygger nära och långsiktiga relationer som ett mindre bolag, men har samtidigt tryggheten och resurserna från vår större koncern, Team Olivia.

title: Pediatrician - Jefferson County Department of Health
description:
TARGET CLOSE DATE:

08/28/2026

PAY GRADE:

Grade 41

TYPE:

Full time

JOB SUMMARY:

Jefferson County Department of Health is seeking a Pediatrician to provide a variety of medical care in the medical specialty area of pediatrics. Pediatricians specialize in the health care needs of infants, children, adolescents, and young adults. A Pediatrician’s work is performed under the administrative direction of the Health Center Administrator and under the medical direction of the Medical Director, but requires considerable independent judgment and decision-making regarding diagnosis and treatment of pediatric patients. Pediatrician job duties include taking patients' medical histories, examining patients, ordering any necessary medical tests, and creating a plan of treatment for the patient. Pediatrician responsibilities include administering vaccinations, providing preventative healthcare, and teaching patients and their parents about proper healthcare, like hygiene and nutrition. Pediatricians supervise some staff to include providing clinical guidance and completing formal performance evaluations.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS:

The role will use ecological evidence to inform land management guidance, identify opportunities for habitat restoration and connectivity, and support the planning and delivery of nature recovery projects.

The Nature Recovery Officer will contribute to the delivery of the Teifi Fyw— Living Teifi: People and Nature Together project, an innovative partnership that brings together conservation organisations, local communities and land managers to address the interconnected challenges of climate change, biodiversity loss and declining river health. title: Test Automation Lead
description:
About the team
Symetra’s Individual Life Division (ILD) is seeking a full-time Test Automation Lead. This is a hands-on, division-level technical leadership role responsible for establishing and driving a unified test automation strategy across ILD delivery teams owning framework standards, mentoring, and hands-on implementation.

About the role
As a technical leader, you will partner with engineers, product owners, QA teams, delivery leads, and stakeholders across ILD and Symetra to champion quality throughout the development lifecycle. You will provide technical leadership that fosters a quality-first mindset and builds consistent automation practices across delivery teams, advancing Symetra’s shift-left, automation-first Quality Engineering model in which quality is built into the development process.
The successful candidate will translate a quality first vision into standardized practice, ultimately improving customer and partner experiences and delivering greater predictability in ILD’s speed to market.

What you will do
  • Define and drive a unified test automation strategy across ILD delivery teams, standardizing secure, scalable tools and frameworks and driving continuous improvement of testing strategies, frameworks, and tools.
  • Utilize Symetra-approved tools and technology for quality engineering purposes for the following:
  • Partner with engineering and DevOps on CI/CD pipelines as code (YAML) in Azure DevOps, defining the automated test execution those pipelines must include.
  • Define the automated quality gates and validation standards for Azure DevOps pipelines — including test execution on pull requests and the criteria for promotion — and partner with engineering and DevOps to implement them and apply release controls.
  • Set the standards for extending quality into production through observability — including synthetic and health-check testing of critical paths — and partner with operations and engineering on monitoring, alerting, and incident feedback loops that continuously improve test coverage.
  • Develop and maintain comprehensive automated tests spanning integration, UI, end-to-end, performance, and security testing that increase coverage and improve the efficiency and reliability of testing cycles.
  • Provide technical direction and mentorship to Software Test Engineers (STEs), SDETs, and delivery-team engineers across ILD delivery teams, leading through influence rather than a direct reporting line and fostering a quality-first mindset.
  • Define and track meaningful automation metrics, including coverage, execution results, stability, failure trends, and test effectiveness.
  • Lead root-cause analysis for complex automation failures, framework issues, and recurring defects, and implement improvements to prevent recurrence.
  • Present and share cloud-based solutions with internal engineering communities for feedback and review.
  • Collaborate effectively in a remote team environment using tools such as Microsoft Teams.

Who You Are
  • Demonstrated experience defining and implementing an enterprise or cross-team test automation strategy, including standardizing tools and frameworks across multiple delivery teams, mentoring engineers, and influencing delivery teams without direct authority.
  • Strong understanding of QA best practices, including shift-left testing, defect triage, and quality metrics, with the ability to use metrics both to drive test coverage, efficiency, and reliability improvements and to communicate automation health and delivery risk to engineering leadership and stakeholders.
  • Experience delivering in Scrum environments.
  • Experience testing AWS-based applications, including serverless or container-based solutions.
  • Hands-on experience building UI and end-to-end test automation with a modern framework such as Playwright and Selenium.
  • Strong experience designing and governing scalable automation frameworks, including coding standards, test strategy, framework architecture, and long-term maintainability.
  • Strong DevOps mindset, with demonstrated success integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or comparable tooling, and measurably improving automation stability, coverage, and maintainability over time.
  • Experience testing APIs and web services using REST, JSON, and XML with tools such as Postman.
  • Experience creating and maintaining test artifacts (test plans, test cases, test strategies), defining testing standards across teams, and keeping artifacts and results traceable in Symetra-approved tools to support compliance and audit expectations.
  • Familiarity with security testing and vulnerability scanning as part of the delivery pipeline.
  • Experience contributing to new solution design and architecture.

Nice to Haves
  • Experience with SpiraTest or a comparable test case management platform for test artifacts and traceability.
  • Experience with AI-assisted testing implementation.
  • Experience with observability tools such as Datadog or Application Insights.
  • Experience with performance and load testing, including defining performance baselines and validating scalability under expected and peak load.
  • Experience in insurance or another regulated financial services environment.

Why Work at Symetra
Here’s what some of our employees have to say about why they work at Symetra:
““I was referred to Symetra by a family friend who’s been with the company for years—and I’m so glad I took their advice. Symetra truly puts its people first. I’ve always felt supported, not micromanaged, and that trust has helped me grow. I started in an entry-level position and have worked my way up to Unit Manager by continuously learning and expanding my skills. It’s a place that believes in its employees and invests in their success.” - Morgan D., Sr. Unit Manager
“"Symetra will spoil you. There aren't many companies that will put as much effort into you being a success as Symetra. The culture will challenge you but simultaneously put you at ease. Failure is seen as integral to the learning process so there is less reason to be fearful of it." - Kerry S., Sr. Systems Analyst

What we offer you
Benefits and Perks
We don’t take a “one-size-fits-all” approach when it comes to our employees. Our programs are designed to make your life better both at work and at home.
  • Flexible full-time or hybrid telecommuting arrangements
  • Plan for your future with our 401(k) plan and take advantage of immediate vesting and company matching up to 6%
  • Paid time away including vacation and sick time, flex days and ten paid holidays
  • Give back to your community and double your impact through our company matching
  • Want more details? Check out our Symetra Benefits Overview
Compensation
Salary Range: $128,700 - $214,600 plus eligibility for annual bonus program
Please review Symetra’s Remote Network Minimum Requirements:
As a remote-first organization committed to providing a positive experience for both employees and customers, Symetra has the following standards for employees’ internet connection:
  • Minimum Internet Speed: 100 Mbps download and 20 Mbps upload, in alignment with the FCC's definition of "broadband."
  • Internet Type: Fiber, Cable (e.g., Comcast, Spectrum), or DSL.
  • Not Permissible: Satellite (e.g., Starlink), cellular broadband (hotspot or otherwise), any other wireless technology, or wired dial-up.
When applying to jobs at Symetra you’ll be asked to test your internet speed and confirm that your internet connection meets or exceeds Symetra’s standard as outlined above.
Identity Verification
Symetra is committed to fair and secure hiring practices. For all roles, candidates will be required (after the initial phone screen) to be on video for all interviews. Symetra will take affirmative steps at key points in the process to verify that a candidate is not seeking employment fraudulently, e.g. through use of a false identity.
Failure to comply with verification procedures may result in:
  • Disqualification from the recruitment process
  • Withdrawal of a job offer
  • Termination of employment and other criminal and/or civil remedies, if fraud is discovered
We empower inclusion
At Symetra, we aspire to be the most inclusive insurance company in the country. We’re building a place where every employee feels valued, respected, and has opportunities to contribute.
Inclusion is about recognizing our assumptions, considering multiple perspective, and removing barriers. We accept and celebrate diverse experiences, identities, and perspectives, because lifting each other up fuels thought and builds a stronger, more innovative company. We invite you to learn more about our efforts here.

Creating a world where more people have access to financial freedom
Symetra is a national financial services company dedicated to helping people achieve their financial goals and feel confident about the future. In our daily work, we’re guided by the principles of Value, Transparency and Sustainability. This means we provide products and services people need at a competitive price, we communicate clearly and openly so people understand what they’re buying, and we design products—and operate our company—to stand the test of time. We’re committed to showing up for our communities, lifting up our employees, and standing up for diversity, equity and inclusion (DEI). Join our team and help us create a world where more people have access to financial freedom.
For more information about our careers visit https://symetra.eightfold.ai/careers

This is a great opportunity for someone who wants to build deeper product-liaison, communications, and project-management experience while gaining exposure to distribution, strategic partnerships, and high-impact business priorities across SPG and USRM.

  • Represent SPG requirements and partner considerations in cross-functional discussions with product teams— identifying opportunities, risks, and operational impacts; coordinating stakeholder engagement; supporting product launches, partner onboarding, operational readiness, and post-launch issue resolution.

title: Principal, Advanced Analytics – Internal Claims Fraud
description:
Description

We’re looking for an experienced, highly independent advanced analytics professional to join our Internal Claims Fraud Advanced Analytics team.

In this stakeholder-focused role, you will analyze complex claims data to identify fraud signals, develop investigator-ready leads, and uncover fraud patterns that protect the company from financial loss. You will partner directly with the Claims Fraud Investigation team and cross-functional operational, data, technology, and analytics teams to turn ambiguous business problems into structured analyses and actionable recommendations.

We are looking for someone who can independently determine the right analytical approach, distinguish signal from noise, challenge assumptions, and translate complex findings into decisions and actions. This is not a reporting or dashboard-development role.

Internal Claims Fraud Analytics is an evolving capability, giving you an exciting opportunity to shape our analytical roadmap, lead-generation approach, data foundation, and future fraud detection capabilities.

What You’ll do

  • Lead complex claims fraud analyses by translating ambiguous investigative questions into clear hypotheses; leverage sound analytical methods to develop recommendations.
  • Conduct exploratory data analysis of claims, payment, employee, and vendor data to proactively identify suspicious patterns, anomalies, control gaps, and emerging fraud risks.
  • Improve the fraud lead-generation lifecycle from initial hypothesis development through signal development, validation, investigator handoff, outcome feedback, and iterative refinement.
  • Develop investigator-ready, comprehensive analyses, not just data pulls; helping stakeholders understand which leads to prioritize and why.
  • Partner closely with the Claims Fraud Investigation team to validate signals, improve lead efficacy, prioritize opportunities, and measure investigative outcomes.
  • Partner with Data Science Modeling and tech teams to translate key analytical findings, like fraud indicators, into model-ready inputs.
  • Independently manage multiple analytics priorities, proactively set expectations, surface tradeoffs, resolve roadblocks, and influence prioritization based on business value.
  • Synthesize complex analysis into concise, compelling recommendations and clearly communicate findings, implications, and tradeoffs to senior leaders.
  • Develop reusable datasets, queries, and documentation to strengthen team's data foundation and accelerate future analysis.

Why You’ll love this role

  • Your work matters: Directly support fraud investigations and protect the company from financial loss.
  • You’ll work in a dynamic, real-world environment: Claims fraud problems are complex and varied; great for someone who loves to learn new things and solve new problems.
  • You’re empowered to improve how we operate: You have the freedom to influence and improve how we detect fraud, generate leads, enable investigators, and build scalable analytical capabilities for the future.

Requirements

  • Experience in fraud, investigative, risk, audit, SIU, or similarly hypothesis-driven analytics.
  • Experience analyzing claims data: navigate complex relationships across claims, exposures, payments, parties, employees, vendors, and other claims-related data.
  • Strong stakeholder orientation: actively listen, challenge and reframe requests when needed, establish clear objectives and expectations, facilitate working sessions, influence prioritization toward the highest-value opportunities.
  • Strong analytical judgment and intellectual curiosity: follow unexpected signals, challenge assumptions, determine whether an apparent anomaly represents meaningful risk.
  • Proven ability to independently lead complex analyses with limited direction, from initial problem framing through recommendation and implementation.
  • Ability to thrive in an ambiguous, evolving environment and help create structure, repeatability, and best practices as the capability matures.
  • Advanced SQL or SAS: complex joins, large datasets, multiple grains of data, query optimization, validation, and development of reusable analytical assets.

What success looks like

  • Be a trusted thought partner for our stakeholders. You think critically and holistically about the data/analysis that will best serve our stakeholders.
  • Our Internal Claims Fraud Investigator stakeholders receive clearer, faster insights that help them prioritize and progress fraud investigations.
  • You deliver meaningful better leads, better decisions, measurable outcomes and scalable capability (e.g., improved detection, reduced losses, smoother stakeholder experience).
  • You develop efficient and reusable queries, clear documentation, and repeatable approaches that the entire team can leverage.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor's Degree plus a minimum 5 years, typically 7 or more years, of related experience required; Mathematics, Economics, Statistics or other quantitative field are preferred fields of study.
  • Master's Degree preferred; advanced education may be substituted for years of experience (Ph.D. with no professional experience).
  • Deep knowledge of data sources, tools and business drivers.
  • Ability to apply advanced analytical concepts to improve business outcomes.
  • Ability to build analytic tools that will be used by business teams to analyze results and opportunities.
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel (VBA, macros, scripts, formulas, data visualization, etc.), PowerPoint, and statistical software packages (SAS, Emblem).
  • Must have good planning, analytical, decision-making and communication skills.
  • Ability to present data, visually and verbally, to guide conversations with business managers.

title: Medico Veterinario - Medicina d'Urgenza (Paderno Dugnano  - MI)
description:
R-251953 Emergency Veterinarian - Paderno

Luogo – Clinica Veterinaria Nord Milano, Paderno Dugnano (MI)

Orario – In regime di libera professione, valutiamo collaborazioni con un impegno indicativo e flessibile di circa 20 ore settimanali. La pianificazione delle attività sarà concordata in modo flessibile in base alle reciproche disponibilità.
L'attività si svolgerà prevalentemente su servizi di Pronto Soccorso serali, notturni e festivi, con la possibilità di prestare servizio presso il reparto di Degenza e nell'area Ambulatoriale, oppure di contribuire alla copertura della reperibilità chirurgica e dei servizi di chirurgia d'urgenza.



Perché unirsi a noi?

  • Lavorerai in una struttura con Pronto Soccorso veterinario attivo 24 ore su 24, confrontandoti con un'ampia varietà di casi urgenti ed emergenze.

  • Entrerai a far parte del team di Medicina d'Urgenza, occupandoti della gestione e della stabilizzazione dei pazienti critici in un contesto clinico dinamico e stimolante.

  • Avrai l'opportunità di confrontarti quotidianamente con un'ampia varietà di casistiche, sviluppando competenze nella gestione delle emergenze e nel processo decisionale clinico.

  • Collaborerai a stretto contatto con i professionisti delle diverse discipline specialistiche, contribuendo alla gestione dei casi complessi attraverso un approccio multidisciplinare.

  • Lavorerai in un ambiente orientato alla condivisione delle competenze, al confronto tra colleghi e alla crescita professionale continua.

  • Entrerai a far parte della rete AniCura, con l'opportunità di sviluppare il tuo percorso professionale all'interno di uno dei principali gruppi di medicina veterinaria in Europa.

Il team

La Clinica Veterinaria Nord Milano, situata a Paderno Dugnano, in zona Palazzolo Milanese, è una struttura dedicata alla cura degli animali da compagnia e offre un servizio veterinario continuativo 24 ore su 24, 7 giorni su 7.

La clinica può contare su un team consolidato di professionisti, che lavora in un ambiente dinamico, stimolante e orientato alla collaborazione. L'attenzione alla qualità delle cure e alla relazione con i proprietari rappresenta uno degli elementi distintivi della struttura.

L'attività clinica si sviluppa in un contesto che favorisce il confronto tra colleghi, la condivisione delle competenze e la gestione integrata dei pazienti, offrendo ai professionisti l'opportunità di lavorare in un ambiente dinamico e in continua evoluzione.

Cosa cerchiamo

  • Laurea in Medicina Veterinaria e regolare iscrizione all'Ordine dei Medici Veterinari, con abilitazione all'esercizio della professione.

  • Possesso di Partita IVA o disponibilità ad attivarla.

  • Interesse per la Medicina d'Urgenza e capacità di gestire i pazienti in situazioni di emergenza, lavorando con efficacia anche in contesti dinamici.

  • Capacità di lavorare in team e di collaborare efficacemente con professionisti appartenenti a diverse discipline specialistiche.

  • Disponibilità a svolgere servizi notturni, nei weekend e nei giorni festivi.

  • Ottime capacità relazionali, comunicative e di gestione del paziente e del cliente.

  • Forte motivazione all'aggiornamento continuo, alla formazione avanzata e allo sviluppo delle proprie competenze professionali.


Cosa offriamo

  • Collaborazione in P. Iva.

  • Possibilità di usufruire di sconti dedicati sui servizi clinici AniCura e presso partner selezionati, tra cui Royal Canin.

  • Accesso alla piattaforma di convenzioni, che offre sconti e offerte speciali su un'ampia gamma di prodotti e servizi.

  • Opportunità di partecipare a seminari e conferenze che favoriscono il continuo aggiornamento professionale e consentono di mantenere le proprie competenze costantemente aggiornate.

  • Formazione continua attraverso programmi di e-learning e percorsi formativi dedicati.

  • Supporto psicologico.


Pronto per il tuo prossimo passo? Candidati oggi e diventa parte della creazione di UN MONDO MIGLIORE PER GLI ANIMALI DOMESTICI.


Chi siamo

AniCura è uno dei principali fornitori europei di cure veterinarie, che riunisce una rete di cliniche e ospedali veterinari dedicati alla salute e al benessere degli animali da compagnia. La nostra ambizione è plasmare il futuro della medicina veterinaria attraverso la collaborazione continua, la condivisione delle migliori pratiche e l'impegno verso i nostri valori fondamentali.

Facciamo parte di Mars Veterinary Health, la più grande azienda veterinaria a conduzione familiare al mondo. Come parte di questa rete globale connessa, ogni anno aiutiamo a curare milioni di animali domestici e sosteniamo le persone che li amano. Essere di proprietà privata ci consente di rimanere concentrati sul nostro Scopo - UN MONDO MIGLIORE PER GLI ANIMALI DOMESTICI - e di investire nell'erogazione di cure veterinarie di alta qualità in ogni fase.

In AniCura, prendersi cura degli animali inizia dal prendersi cura delle nostre persone. Siamo orgogliosi di una cultura basata sulla collaborazione, sull'apprendimento e sul supporto, in cui i colleghi sono incoraggiati a svilupparsi sia personalmente sia professionalmente. Le nostre persone sono al centro di tutto ciò che facciamo e sono ciò che ci distingue davvero. Quando ti unisci ad AniCura, diventi parte di qualcosa di più grande: un'organizzazione internazionale in crescita che sta contribuendo a creare un futuro prospero per le cure veterinarie e per i professionisti che le rendono possibili.

AniCura è un datore di lavoro che garantisce pari opportunità e tutti i candidati qualificati saranno presi in considerazione per l'assunzione indipendentemente da razza, colore, religione, sesso, orientamento sessuale, identità di genere, origine nazionale, stato di disabilità, appartenenza alle categorie protette o qualsiasi altra caratteristica protetta dalla legge. Se hai bisogno di assistenza o di un adattamento durante il processo di candidatura a causa di una disabilità, tale assistenza è disponibile su richiesta scrivendo a giada.malerba@anicura.it. AniCura è lieta di fornire tale assistenza e nessun candidato sarà penalizzato a seguito di tale richiesta.

title: Multimedia Designer - Freelance, Remote
description:
About the Client
Our client is a well-established media and broadcasting company with a nationwide footprint, reaching over 20 million listeners weekly through dozens of radio stations across multiple U.S. markets. With a rich history spanning six decades, the company blends legacy media reach with a growing digital presence, serving advertisers, communities, and audiences through radio, digital platforms, and live events.

Why does this role exist?
This role exists because the client needs a dedicated creative partner who can translate their brand and campaign vision into polished, ready-to-use visual assets across every channel they operate in — from radio branding and events to digital advertising and sales collateral. As the company runs campaigns across many stations, markets, and departments simultaneously, they need someone who can independently manage a high volume of design requests without sacrificing quality or consistency. Ultimately, this hire will free up the Corporate Creative, Marketing, Digital, and Sales teams to move faster by giving them a reliable, self-directed designer who can execute confidently from concept to final file. This is a dedicated design execution role — it is intentionally scoped to multimedia/graphic design and does not extend into social media management, marketing strategy, or web development.
Brand & Campaign Design
  • Develop branding and creative assets for radio stations, events, and campaigns
  • Design logos, advertisements, print collateral, vehicle graphics, web graphics, and digital ads
  • Create cohesive visual campaigns that work seamlessly across print, websites, apps, and social media
Sales & Presentation Materials
  • Create customized sales proposals, presentations, and marketing packages
  • Translate designs into fully editable PowerPoint presentations for sales teams
Digital & Web Content
  • Develop digital ads and other creative products for the client's brands
  • Design, update, and maintain visual content for WordPress websites
Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Collaborate with Corporate Creative, Marketing, Digital, and Sales teams on campaigns and events
  • Participate in creative brainstorming and concept development sessions
Project & Workflow Management
  • Manage multiple concurrent design projects while meeting deadlines and maintaining quality
  • Support video editing and multimedia projects as needed
Required:
  • Professional Graphic/Multimedia Design experience, with a strong portfolio showcasing branding, digital advertising, social media, and marketing materials
  • Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign)
  • Hands-on experience using WordPress to create and edit website content
  • Hands-on experience using PowerPoint to produce fully editable presentations
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
Your superpowers are...
  • Technical Skills
    • Mastery of Adobe Creative Cloud (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign)
    • Working knowledge of WordPress for website content updates
    • Strong PowerPoint design skills for editable, sales-ready presentations
    • Ability to translate a single design concept across multiple platforms and formats (print, digital, social, web)
    • Video editing skills (a strong plus, not required)

  • Soft Skills
    • Highly creative with strong attention to detail
    • Self-directed and comfortable working independently with minimal oversight
    • Excellent time management and ability to juggle multiple competing priorities
    • Strong collaborator who takes direction well across different departments
    • Clear, professional communicator in both written and verbal English
WFH Set-Up:
  • Computer with at least 8GB RAM, an Intel i5 core processor/AMD Ryzen 5 Processor and up.
  • Internet speed of at least 40MBPS
  • Headset with an extended mic that has noise cancellation and a webcam
  • Back-up computer and internet connection
  • Quiet, dedicated workspace at home
You should apply if...
  • You're the kind of designer who takes pride in producing clean, professional work even when you're juggling five projects at once.
  • You don't need heavy hand-holding — give you a brief and a deadline, and you'll run with it, asking smart questions along the way.
  • You enjoy variety in your design work, whether that's a logo one day, a sales deck the next, and a WordPress update after that.
  • You see feedback as part of the creative process, not a setback, and you genuinely enjoy collaborating with marketing, sales, and creative teams to bring campaigns to life. If "fast-paced, multi-brand, deadline-driven" sounds exciting rather than exhausting, this role is for you.
What to expect...

Work Setup:
  • Remote position
  • Must have a reliable internet connection and a quiet workspace
  • Required to provide own computer with Intel Core i5 or something similar or higher operating system
Working Hours:
  • 40 hours per week
  • Monday–Friday, 8:30 am–5:30 pm Eastern Time
Compensation:
  • $7 per hour
  • No benefits package included

title: Broista - Merlin, OR
description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly believe in what they are doing. At Dutch Bros Coffee, we are more than just a coffee company. We are a fun-loving, mind-blowing company that makes a difference one cup at a time.

The Dutch Bros Mission is to love people, make a difference in the community and provide extraordinary experiences to all.Broistas are the foundation of our culture, upholding our fundamental philosophy of love all, serve all.

You are

  • A Team Player.You are enthusiastic about the success of others just as you are about yourself.

  • Authentic.You are your unique self.

  • Adaptable.You feel comfortable adjusting to changing circumstances and encourage your teammates to do the same. We learn and grow, together!

  • People-first.You radiate kindness and positivity in every interaction you have with others.

You will

  • Engage. You get to meet new people, every day! Greet and thank each customer with a smile and provide them with their moment of special.

  • Ask and Educate. Each customer has different needs and it’s up to you to help them out. This is a chance to help customers learn our menu, different products, and current specials.

  • Embody. Culture at Dutch Bros means everything. We may be a beverage company, but ultimately, we are in the relationship business.

  • Be Consistent. Our core values are speed, quality, and service. It’s important that the customer gets exactly what they ordered.

  • Be Positive. Make all your friends feel there is something in them. Look at the sunny side of everything, and make your optimism come true.

  • Be Reliable. Show up to work on time and ready to go! Communicate availability needs and follow proper call out procedures.

  • Help out. Stuff may come up, be prepared to support as needed.

We will

  • Empower you. We will empower you to be generous through the window.

  • Give you opportunities to give back. Every employee receives 8 hours of paid volunteer time to spend time in their community.

  • Support your physical and mental health. We care about our employees’ wellbeing. Through our Employee Assistance Program and Employee Resource Groups, we’ve got you covered.

  • Care about your development. Our Education Benefit Program will provide you with up to $5,250 per year towards your professional development after you’ve worked with us for one year.

  • Celebrate. We’ll provide you with Dutch Bros swag and ensure you stay hydrated with free drinks.

  • Equip you with the tools to be successful. As you onboard, our training program will set you up to win.

  • Contribute to your 401(k). Free money? We’ll match up to 4% of your contribution as soon as you are eligible!

  • Add you to the tips pool. Our customers are extremely generous! This position is eligible to participate in a tip pool only after completing and passing Broista training.

The facts

  • Know your resources.It’s important that you adhere to all company policies and procedures as laid out in theMafia ManifestoandEmployee Handbook.

  • Be on time.Ensure you have reliable transportation and can be on time for scheduled shifts and mandatory meetings.

  • Food Handler Permit or Certification.As a prerequisite to employment, you’ll need to obtain and maintain this as required by state or local regulations.

  • Complete, pass, and maintain trainings.We promised to set you up for success. Trainings, certifications, and knowledge tests will ensure you can meet Dutch Bros standards and policies. Federal, state, and local regulations will be included.

  • Math.Don’t worry, it’s just cash! You might be required to do mental math at times.

  • Communication.Written, oral, and verbal English proficiency is required. Other language fluency is highly valued. Talking, expressing, or exchanging ideas by means of verbal communication happens regularly. You may be expected to view things from near and/or far distances.

  • What to expect.You might stand, walk or be in movement during your working hours, which can be up to 10 hours in a shift, so take those breaks to recharge! There may be possible stooping, kneeling, or crawling. You may need to push, pull, lift, or carry up to 65 lbs, talk about a workout. At times, you may be exposed to some pretty chilly or hot weather, but we have Dutch gear to help! Occasional ascending or descending on ladders or ramps is a possibility. Working at Dutch Bros includes frequent, continual, intermittent flexing, or rotation of the wrist(s) and spine.

Compensation:

Up to $19.80 per hour

Number includes an average tip of $4.25 per hour.

What we strive for: a fun environment, great co-workers, and a chance to make a difference in your community. What we don't guarantee: tip averages. Actual tips may vary based on a variety of factors including location, position, hours, and quality of service. Average hourly tips are based on 2024 reporting.

If you like wild growth and working in a unique and fun environment, surrounded by positive community, you'll enjoy your career with us!

title: Product Designer - APP
description:
The Role

Help us build the operating system for human longevity.

Virtusan is a Swiss-based longevity ecosystem at the intersection of science, technology, and premium real-world experiences. We connect data, behaviour, and environments so people can live longer, better lives. We're a small team and offer real ownership from day one.

We need someone who owns their work completely: defines the experience, conducts the research, designs the flows, and iterates without waiting to be asked.

This is not just an execution role. You will shape how our app is used, how it guides people through their health data, and whether it actually changes how they live. You will be accountable for outcomes, not just outputs. The measure of your work is whether users build real habits, understand their biology, and come back because the product earns it.

Tasks

What You'll Own

Product concept and experience design

  • Originate new product concepts from scratch, not just improve what exists
  • Design complete user journeys that translate complex biometric data into clear, motivating daily guidance
  • Ensure every flow serves behaviour change, not just usability: ask why a feature exists and what it helps the user to accomplish, not just how it should work
  • Hold the line on experience quality across the full app

User research

description:

JOB SUMMARY:

The City of Midfield is seeking a well-qualified Parks and Recreation Superintendent that is responsible for planning, organizing, and administering recreational projects and programs for the city. The Parks and Recreation Superintendent oversees the upkeep and maintenance activities for all recreational facilities and grounds to ensure activities are safe and available for citizens. Employees in this job class also prepare and administer the budget, procure and manage inventory, and provide supervision and guidance to subordinate staff. They are required to exercise considerable judgment within the realm of established guidelines and procedures. The work of a Parks and Recreation Superintendent is performed both indoors in an office setting, as well as regular field visits to outdoor worksites.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS:

The City of Midfield provides competitive pay and comprehensive benefits packages to include medical and dental insurance, employer-sponsored retirement plan (pension), generous paid holidays, sick and vacation leave, and more. The pay range for this job is presented below:

$47,632 - $73,902

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

The following are job-related qualifications required for employment consideration for this position. Minimum qualifications are subject to change:

  • Driver's license.

  • Supervisory experience to include assigning tasks, delegating/reviewing work, training, and providing performance feedback.

  • Experience assisting with budgetary responsibilities to include developing/reporting budgets and monitoring expenditures.

  • Experience maintaining parks and recreational grounds such as marking fields and overseeing the layout/setup of sports fields for organized sports (e.g., soccer, baseball, football).

  • Experience assisting with the implementation and/or administration of community wide events such as organized Easter egg hunts, parades, celebrations, festivals, and youth/adult sports leagues.

TYPICAL JOB DUTIES:

  • Plans, organizes, directs, implements, and evaluates recreational programs, projects, and facilities by establishing plans and goals for the future, conducting needs and budget analysis, coordinating with staff on development and implementation, creating rules, policies, and procedures, and promoting recreational services to enrich the community.

  • Prepares, monitors, and administers departmental or organizational budget by reviewing spending trends, expenditure reports, analyzing financial data, and ensuring expenditures are within annual budgetary limits.

  • Procures and/or manages inventory (i.e., supplies and equipment) to ensure the products and services are available to meet the operational needs of each department.

  • Oversees the upkeep and maintenance activities of city parks, sports complexes, recreational facilities, schools, city properties, and surrounding grounds.

  • Supervises staff by assigning and distributing work, directing staff in their job duties, monitoring progress of work, providing feedback and/or training.

  • Performs general administrative duties including reviewing/producing reports, letters, and other types of written correspondence, attending meetings, conferences, addressing complaints/concerns, etc. as needed to maintain appropriate documentation, develop job standards, ensure up-to-date processes, and efficient operation of the department.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

Job is primarily sedentary involving sitting for long periods of time. At times, job may require light to moderate physical exertion, including lifting, carrying, bending, stooping, kneeling, crouching, or twisting. Job may also involve occasional lifting of items or objects weighing up to 50 lbs.

WORK ENVIRONMENT:

Work is conducted both indoors in an office setting as well as regular field visits to outdoor worksites. Incumbents may be required to work nights and/or weekends. Job may include exposure to potentially hazardous working conditions (e.g., moving vehicles, biological and/or chemical hazards, etc.). description:

The Application Engineer - DX & VRV plays a key role in delivering technically sound, optimized, and commercially competitive HVAC solutions across Daikin's sales organization. You will work closely with Sales, Product Management, Engineering, and other internal stakeholders, and ensure that proposed DX and VRV solutions meet customer requirements, local regulations, and Daikin engineering standards while contributing to successful project execution and business growth in Qatar. Provide application engineering support to all Sales functions throughout the project lifecycle, from project inquiry to order confirmation. Design, size, and select DX, VRV and AHU equipment using Daikin selection software (VRV, AHU selection software, and other approved engineering tools). Review project specifications, tender documents, HVAC drawings, and schedules to develop compliant and optimized technical solutions. Validate equipment selections to ensure technical feasibility, energy efficiency, compliance with project requirements, and adherence to Daikin engineering standards. Prepare technical submittals, equipment schedules, selection reports, and engineering documentation to support project proposals. Provide value engineering recommendations and alternative solutions that improve technical performance and commercial competitiveness. Coordinate with Product Management, Sales, Factory Engineering, and other internal teams to resolve technical queries and ensure timely project support. Support quotation preparation by providing accurate technical selections, engineering calculations, and costing inputs. Participate in technical meetings with consultants, customers, contractors, and internal stakeholders to present solutions, discuss design requirements, and address application-related questions. Stay current with HVAC technologies, local regulations, industry standards, and Daikin product developments to provide best in class application support. Ensure smooth technical handover to the execution team following order confirmation. What You Need To Succeed Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, HVAC Engineering, or a related engineering discipline. Minimum 5 years of experience in HVAC Application Engineering, Technical Support, or HVAC System Design, with strong expertise in DX and VRV systems, preferably within the Qatar or GCC market. Strong knowledge of HVAC system design, equipment selection, psychometrics, heat load calculations, and energy efficient system applications. Hands on experience using HVAC selection and design software, including VRV, Auto CAD, AHU selection software and Microsoft Office applications. Solid understanding of MEP drawings, HVAC design standards, tender specifications, and consultant requirements. Proven experience providing technical support across multiple sales channels, including equipment selection, solution optimization, value engineering, and technical proposal development. Ability to analyze project requirements, identify technical risks, and recommend practical engineering solutions. Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to build effective relationships with consultants, contractors, customers, and internal stakeholders. Excellent planning, organizational, and problem solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and meet tight deadlines. Fluent in English. Arabic language skills are an advantage. Knowledge of international HVAC standards (ASHRAE and AHRI) and familiarity with the Qatar Construction Specifications (QCS) and other applicable local regulations will be an advantage. Good climate starts with people

Our employees are the beating heart of our company. At Daikin, you get to work in a positive environment backed by trust, creativity and continuous improvement. Together, we create our top-quality solutions by empowering talented teams. You will get plenty of opportunities to learn and grow. We are deeply committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace culture that reflects the communities we serve. Good climate starts with people.

title: Physician - Clinical AI Expert (Remote)
description:
We are seeking physicians to review, validate and design clinical tasks to help advance frontier AI models across a range of clinical scenarios and formats.

The project is designed to surface where models perform poorly in clinical scenarios such missed findings, incorrect clinical information, overconfidence or failure to seek context before answering.

You will work asynchronously on a dedicated platform, within your own specialty and day-to-day scope of practice.

This is a remote, flexible and short-term project.

Key Responsibilities

  • Scenario Design: Design realistic clinical scenarios and instructions that mirror the work you carry out day-to-day in your specialty.

  • Content Review: Assess clinical outputs for accuracy, flagging anything incorrect, outdated or can cause harm.

  • Reference Answer Validation: Judge whether reference answers reflect what you would actually write in practice, including caveats, uncertainty and requests for further information.

  • Grading Criteria Assessment: Design and evaluate whether scoring criteria capture what matters clinically and whether each is weighted appropriately, particularly safety-critical items.

  • Written Rationale: Provide short, specific reasoning where you disagree, and note the weakness each new item is designed to expose.

  • Feedback & Continuous Improvement: Highlight edge cases and ambiguity to refine guidelines and improve consistency across reviewers.


Qualifications

  • Licensure: Registered doctor based in the US, Europe or Asia-Pacific.

  • Experience: Current or recent clinical practice in your stated specialty.

  • Knowledge: Strong grounding in current guidelines, diagnostic reasoning and clinical documentation standards.

  • Attention to detail: Proven accuracy and consistency in clinical review or assessment work.

  • Technical proficiency: Comfortable using structured review tools and digital platforms.

  • Language: Native or near-native written English.


Legal Status

  • You will have the right to work in your country of residence.

  • You will work as an independent contractor.


Why Join Us?

  • Flexible Work Arrangements: Part-time, remote and fully asynchronous.

  • Competitive Compensation: Hourly rate in line with specialty and level of experience.

  • Professional Development: Direct involvement in how frontier AI models are evaluated for clinical safety, working alongside clinicians and AI researchers.

Our solutions combine connectivity, data, automation, and AI to shape the future of digital work for millions of users around the world.

We are looking for a technically strong and product-minded Product Manager to join our AI Product Team and shape how TeamViewer connects with partner systems, data sources, AI frameworks, and agentic ecosystems. In this role, you will define and drive a cross-product integration roadmap that helps customers, partners, and internal teams unlock more value from TeamViewer products. You will work at the intersection of AI, APIs, data, enterprise software, and partnerships - turning technical possibilities into scalable product capabilities with real customer impact.

Responsibilities

  • Own the integration strategy and roadmap: Define where and how TeamViewer should integrate with third-party systems across the product portfolio, balancing customer value, partner opportunity, technical feasibility, and long-term platform scalability.

  • Build impactful partner and data integrations: Identify, prioritize, and deliver integrations that connect TeamViewer with partner and customer systems to extract, contribute, synchronize, and operationalize data in secure, reliable, and enterprise-ready ways.

  • Shape our agentic AI ecosystem: Help define TeamViewer’s approach to AI interoperability, including integrations with AI frameworks, model and tool ecosystems, Model Context Protocol (MCP), Agent-to-Agent (A2A) patterns, and emerging standards for agent-to-tool and agent-to-agent communication.

  • Turn complex needs into clear product requirements: Translate partner, customer, and internal use cases into crisp product requirements, API contracts, integration specifications, acceptance criteria, and technical trade-offs that engineering teams can execute with confidence.

  • Drive partnerships from idea to adoption: Collaborate with Business Development, Partnerships, Engineering, Security, Legal, Sales, Customer Success, and external partners to evaluate opportunities, align joint roadmaps, remove blockers, and bring integrations successfully to market.

  • Create reusable platform capabilities: Scale integration work beyond individual projects by driving reusable connectors, documentation, enablement materials, observability, success metrics, and self-service patterns that can be adopted across TeamViewer products.

Requirements

  • Several years of experience in technical product management, platform product management, API products, enterprise integrations, developer ecosystems, AI products, or comparable B2B SaaS roles.

  • Strong technical fluency in APIs, data exchange patterns, webhooks, authentication and authorization concepts, integration middleware, cloud platforms, and enterprise-grade reliability, scalability, privacy, and security expectations.

  • Proven ability to define and deliver third-party integrations, excellent partner management skills, connector platforms, partner-facing APIs, or data-intensive products that connect multiple systems and workflows.

  • Curiosity and practical experience with AI and GenAI ecosystems, including LLM application patterns, tool calling, retrieval-augmented generation, AI framework integrations, agentic workflows, MCP, A2A, or comparable interoperability standards.

  • Comfort working closely with engineering teams on architecture, feasibility, technical dependencies, release planning, quality, observability, and operational readiness.

title: Senior Analyst, Advanced Analytics: Auto Physical Damage (APD)
description:
Description

The Auto Physical Damage (APD) Data Science team builds and deploys data science products that power faster, more consistent, and more accurate claims outcomes. Our portfolio spans both traditional machine learning models and Generative AI systems (e.g., document summarization, LLM-driven decision support, and unstructured-data extraction). As our model footprint grows, ensuring these systems remain accurate, reliable, and trustworthy in production is mission-critical.

We are seeking a Model Monitoring Analyst to design, build, and operate the systems that keep our production models healthy. You will be the owner of model observability across the APD portfolio - establishing how we detect performance degradation, data drift, and anomalous behavior for both classical ML and GenAI systems. This is a highly visible role that partners closely with data scientists, ML engineers, claims business partners, and model governance teams.

**Candidates who live within 50 miles of Boston, MA; Portsmouth, NH; Seattle, WA; Columbus, OH; or Plano, TX will follow a hybrid schedule, coming into the office two days per week. Otherwise, this role is remote with occasional travel.**

Key Responsibilities

  • Build monitoring infrastructure for production models, covering both traditional ML and GenAI/LLM systems, including automated pipelines, dashboards, and alerting.
  • Define and track model health metrics – for ML: accuracy, precision/recall, AUC, calibration, feature and prediction drift. For GenAI: output quality, hallucination/grounding checks, relevance, latency, token/cost usage, and guardrail adherence.
  • Detect and diagnose issues such as data drift, concept drift, performance decay, and data-quality breaks, then triage and escalate to the appropriate model owners.
  • Establish thresholds and alerting that balance early detection with alert fatigue, and document expected behavior and remediation runbooks.
  • Partner with data scientists and ML engineers to integrate monitoring into the model deployment lifecycle (CI/CD, MLOps/LLMOps).
  • Support model governance and compliance by producing monitoring evidence, audit-ready reporting, and documentation aligned with enterprise model risk management standards.
  • Analyze production outcomes against business KPIs to surface opportunities for model improvement or retraining.
  • Communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders through reporting and periodic model health reviews.

The ideal candidate will have:

  • Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, or related), or equivalent experience.
  • 3+ years of experience in data analytics, data science, ML engineering, or a related analytical role.
  • Proficiency in SQL and Python for data manipulation and analysis.
  • Solid understanding of machine learning concepts and model performance evaluation.
  • Experience building dashboards and reports (e.g., Streamlit, Tableau, or similar).
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with attention to detail.

Additionally:

  • Graduate degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, or related), or equivalent experience.
  • Experience with model monitoring / observability tooling
  • Experience with A/B testing or experiment design to test impact of solutions
  • Familiarity with GenAI/LLM evaluation concepts – prompt/response quality, hallucination detection, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), guardrails, and LLM cost/latency monitoring.
  • Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and MLOps/LLMOps practices.
  • Knowledge of the auto claims or insurance domain.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor's Degree plus a minimum 3 years, typically 4 or more years of experience, or equivalent, is required.
  • Mathematics, Economics, Statistics or other quantitative field are preferred fields of study.
  • Advanced knowledge of data sources, tools, statistical principles and methodologies, and techniques.
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel (VBA, macros, scripts, formulas, data visualization, etc.), PowerPoint, and statistical software packages (SAS, Emblem).
  • Must have good planning, analytical, decision-making and communication skills. Solid understanding of business to improve business outcomes.

title: WordPress and Data Specialist
description:
The Role

We’re looking for an experienced WordPress and Data Specialist for a full-time role combining two areas. You will take over ongoing development, maintenance, and optimization of our website, working directly with our marketing team on a steady stream of build, integration, content, and performance work. Alongside this, you will support our finance team with hands-on data work – building financial data structures and driving initiatives to integrate and automate data flows between the systems we use.

What You Will Do

• Ongoing Maintenance: Keep plugins and themes updated, clean up unused assets/plugins, and monitor site speed and uptime across 2 sites.

• New Pages & Redesigns: Build and restyle landing pages, product pages, and section redesigns in Elementor (e.g. homepage, consulting/software pages, regional project pages).

• Interactive Features: Build and maintain interactive maps (office locations, product maps), interactive images with clickable hotspots, and custom popups.

• Forms & Lead Generation: Add/edit HubSpot form fields, set up UTM capture, wire form submissions into GA4, and improve spam filtering.

• Analytics & SEO: Build GA4 explorations and reports, fix tracking gaps, resolve SemRush-flagged errors, manage CookieYes consent settings, and troubleshoot indexing issues.

• Third-Party Integrations: Maintain the Team Tailor careers widget, HubSpot, and other embedded scripts as requirements change.

• User Access & Membership: Manage the gated candidates/consultant catalogue, the gated ESOX map, custom user roles, and login access.

• Content Edits: Blog post templates, testimonials, FAQs, comparison tables, contact/office pages, and general copy or layout tweaks requested by the marketing team.

• Bug Fixes: Redirects, broken layouts on specific screen sizes, iframe/lazy-load conflicts, and widget/plugin issues.

• Documentation & Enablement: Write short how-to guides so our internal team can make simple edits independently, reserving specialist time for the more technical work.

• Financial Data Management: Support the finance team in owning the structure, accuracy, and consistency of financial data across systems, helping structure, clean, and maintain financial data.

• Data Integration & Automation: Drive initiatives to integrate and automate data flows between the tools we use (ERP, BI/reporting tools, Excel), helping the finance team build data structures and automations. Together with the point above, this data work will take up to half of your engagement.

What We Are Looking For

• Demonstrable hands-on experience with WordPress + Elementor on live production sites (portfolio or references required), including theme customization, plugin management, and maintaining multiple related sites/subdomains.

• Core front-end skills: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/jQuery, and enough PHP to troubleshoot theme/plugin code.

• Practical experience with at least some of: HubSpot, Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, CookieYes, SemRush, Team Tailor (or equivalent tools in each category).

• Web performance optimization skills: image compression/format conversion (WebP), caching plugins (e.g. PhastPress), script deferral, and improving Core Web Vitals / PageSpeed scores.

• A data mindset paired with working knowledge of the relevant tools (ERP, BI/reporting tools, Excel) – since the data work will take up to half of your engagement, hands-on experience structuring, cleaning, and maintaining data is needed to an extent.

• Solid proficiency in Excel (pivot tables, lookups, basic automation).

• Able to work independently from a written ticket/request (we manage work in Trello) and turn around small requests quickly, while flagging bigger changes for approval.

• Strong attention to detail and the ability to carefully review requirements and instructions before executing tasks.

Working at LAUTEC

At LAUTEC, we value collaboration, curiosity, and innovation. Our culture is based on trust, flexibility, and self-motivation. We are true to our Danish roots with a flat hierarchy and development opportunities for all employees.

About LAUTEC

LAUTEC is a specialist provider of consultancy and SaaS services for renewable energy projects worldwide. Passionate about technology and motivated by accelerating the global energy transition, LAUTEC’s vision is to transition all power generation into renewables. With offices in Copenhagen, Taipei, Boston, Melbourne, and Seoul, the company enables the public and private sectors to realize wind power and other renewable energy projects smarter, faster, and cheaper.

title: Senior Director, Clinical Care Coordination
description:
The Senior Director of Clinical Care Coordination is a strategic clinical leader responsible for overseeing care coordination, clinical escalations, case management, and client placement across the CCS network. This role ensures that high-quality, person-centered care is delivered consistently and effectively, with a strong emphasis on clinical outcomes, provider collaboration, and operational excellence.

The Senior Director leads multiple teams, including the Clinical Case Management Team, and is accountable for ensuring that client families progress through their care paths with appropriate consultation, oversight, and support. This role drives clinical strategy, optimizes care delivery systems, and fosters a culture of continuous improvement and high performance.
Additionally, the Senior Director oversees client placement and access to services, ensuring timely, equitable, and clinically appropriate service delivery across the network. This includes managing referral pathways, service availability, and coordination with provider partners to meet client needs.

The Senior Director partners closely with executive leadership to align clinical operations with organizational goals, regulatory standards, and industry best practices. This role also serves as a key representative of CCS in external engagements and regulatory communications.

Strategic Leadership & Oversight

  • Lead and manage the specialized care and clinical case management teams, ensuring alignment with CCS’s strategic objectives.
  • Develop and implement clinical strategies to improve care path adherence, client outcomes, and provider engagement.
  • Provide clinical oversight for high-risk cases and escalations, ensuring timely and effective resolution.

Clinical Case Management & Care Coordination

  • Oversee the Clinical Case Management Team, ensuring comprehensive assessment, planning, coordination, and evaluation of client care.
  • Establish protocols for case reviews, risk stratification, and multidisciplinary collaboration.
  • Monitor case management metrics and outcomes, driving improvements in service delivery and client satisfaction.
  • Provide oversight of Care Coordinator team operations, driving process efficiency and accountability to ensure the accurate and timely processing of clinical reports and authorizations.

Client Placement & Access to Services

  • Oversee client placement processes, ensuring timely and appropriate matching with providers based on clinical need, geography, and service availability.
  • Manage referral pathways and ensure equitable access to services across the CCS network.
  • Collaborate with provider partners to optimize capacity and reduce barriers to care.
  • Monitor placement trends and access metrics, identifying gaps and implementing solutions.

Operational Excellence

  • Optimize tools, workflows, and resources to support efficient and effective clinical operations.
  • Analyze clinical trends and performance data to inform decision-making and strategic planning.
  • Ensure compliance with all regulatory requirements and internal policies.

Provider Network Engagement

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with CCS provider partners to support collaborative care delivery.
  • Provide clinical consultation and support to providers, ensuring adherence to treatment guidelines and best practices.

Culture & Team Development

  • Promote a person-first culture that prioritizes client needs and fosters respectful, constructive team dynamics.
  • Support professional development and training for clinical staff, ensuring competency and confidence in service delivery.
  • Lead staffing decisions, including hiring, performance management, and team assignments.

Escalation Management

  • Implement proactive strategies to prevent and manage clinical escalations.
  • Oversee resolution of complaints and grievances, ensuring timely and client-centered outcomes.
  • Foster a culture of continuous improvement in escalation handling and service recovery.

Collaboration & Communication

  • Partner with Clinical Excellence and other departments to develop and maintain treatment plan guidelines.
  • Communicate industry trends and recommended enhancements to leadership.
  • Represent CCS in regulatory inspections, stakeholder meetings, and cross-functional initiatives.

Other Duties

  • Support implementation of care path modifications and new modalities.
  • Complete additional responsibilities as assigned by the Vice President of Network Operations.

Qualifications

Minimum Education, Experience & Training Equivalent to:

  • 8+ years of experience working in a home-health setting with supervisory responsibilities
  • Licensed Clinical Psychologist, LMFT, LPCC or LCSW required.
  • 5+years of progressive leadership experience in clinical operations, including oversight of clinical operations, access and client care management.
  • Experience working with individuals with autism spectrum disorders (ASD) and related developmental disabilities.
  • Proven success in strategic planning, program development and managing remote teams
  • Experience in strategic planning and collaboration with executive and key operational groups preferred.

Requests:

  • Must be able to communicate effectively within the work environment, read and write using the primary language with the workplace.
  • Visual and auditory ability to work with clients, staff, and others in the workplace continuously.
  • Frequent speaking and listening (25-75%) to clients, staff, and others in the workplace.
  • Ability to utilize computer, cell phone (iPhone).
  • Frequent sitting.
  • Ability to utilize virtual meetings software (Zoom, Teams, etc.).
  • Knowledgeable in evidence-based methodologies found to benefit individuals diagnosed with developmental disabilities, including Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA), Early Start Denver Model (ESDM), Treatment and Education of Autistic and related Communication-Handicapped Children (TEACCH), Picture Exchange Communication System (PECS), and Pivotal Response Training (PRT).
  • Training in the field of ABA/Behavioral Health Treatment, and knowledge of other community resources and agencies that serve children.
  • Experience interpreting and implementing policies, procedures, and regulations of CCS.
  • Highly Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel, etc.). especially Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Strong analytical skills.
  • Strong interpersonal skills.
